sa: दुर्योधनस्तु दशभिर्गार्धपत्रैः शिलाशितैः। भीमसेनं महेष्वासं रुक्मपुङ्खः समार्पयत्॥
en: Duryodhana pierced the mighty bow-man Bhimasena with ten shafts furnished with vulture-feathers and whetted on stone and decked with gold.

sa: योत्स्यमानानवेक्षेऽहं य एतेऽत्र समागताः। धार्तराष्ट्रस्य दुर्बुद्धेयुद्धे प्रियचिकीर्षवः॥
en: I shall see those who have assembled here to fight, wishing to do good to the evil-minded son of Dhritarashtra.

sa: स तैरग्न्यर्कसंकाशैः शरैराशीविषोपमैः। शितैरभ्यर्दितो रामो मन्दचेता इवाभवत्॥
en: Rama, struck with those arrows which were like fire or the sun and like poisonous snakes, became like one senseless.

sa: चक्रे वायुः पृष्ठतः पाण्डवानां धार्तराष्ट्राश्वापदा व्यारहन्त। गजेन्द्राणां मदग्न्धांश्च तीव्रान् न सेहिरे तव पुत्रस्य नागाः॥
en: The wind blew from behind the Pandavas. The beasts of prey yelled, from behind the troops of your sons. The elephants, belonging to your son, could not bear the strong odour of the juice emitted by the large (Pandava) elephants.

sa: भीमसेनं सुसंक्रुद्ध गाङ्गेयस्य वधैषिणम्॥ त्वरमाणो महाराज सौमदत्तिर्यवारयत्।
en: O monarch, then with great activity Somadatta's encountered Bhimasena inflamed with rage and exerting for the slaughter of Ganga's son.

sa: वृष्णीनांवासुदेवोऽस्मि पाण्डवानां धनंजयः। मुनीनामप्यहं व्यासः कवीनामुशना कविः॥
en: I am Vasudeva among Vrishnis and Arjuna among the Pandavas. I am Vyasa among Rishis, and Ushanas among the Seers.

sa: दैवं पुरुषकारेण को निवर्तितुमुत्सहेत्। पृथिवीक्षयशंसीनि निमित्तानि पितामह॥
en: What person ever ventures to overcome Destiny by human endeavor? Numerous protects, O grandsire, indicating the destruction of the earth,

sa: तदन्वेव विराटश्च द्रुपदश्च महारथः॥ तदनन्तरमेवासीन्नीलो नीलायुधैः सह।
en: Next to him stood those two great carwarriors Virata and Drupada; next to them was Nila armed with poisonous weapons.

sa: तस्मिंस्तु घोरे संग्रामे वर्तमाने भयंकरे। दुःसहो नवभिर्बाणैरभिमन्युमविध्यत॥ दुःशासनो द्वादशभिः कृपः शारद्वतस्त्रिभिः। द्रोणस्तु सप्तदशभिः शरैराशीविषोपमैः॥
en: Thus when that awful and terrible combat raged fiercely, Dussaha pierced Abhimanyu with nine arrows, Dushasana pierced him with twelve, Kripa and the son of Saradvata with three, Drona with seventeen arrows, all resembling so many snakes of virulent poison.

sa: अपसृत्याप्रतिश्रुत्य प्रजासंहरणं तदा। त्वरमाणा च राजेन्द्र मृत्युर्धेनुकमभ्यगात्॥
en: Then without having promised the destruction of creatures, she went away, O king; and then Death hastily came to Dhenuka.

sa: विशिरस्कैर्मनुष्यैश्च च्छिन्नगात्रैश्च वारणैः। अश्वैः सम्भिन्नदेहैश्च संकीर्णाभूद् वसुन्धरा॥
en: The earth was covered with headless trucks with mutilated elephants and with horses with limbs mangled and hacked to pieces.

sa: ततोऽगमद् वत्सभूमि सिद्धचारणसेविताम्। आश्रमं पुण्यशीलानां तापसानां महात्मनाम्॥
en: Then she went to Vatsabhumi, resorted to by Siddhas and Charanas, and the retreat of high-souled ascetics of pious deeds.

sa: गौतमोऽपि धनुस्त्यक्त्वा प्रगृह्यासिं सुसंयतः। वेगेन महता राजंश्चेकितानमुपाद्रवत्॥
en: Thereupon Kripa also having laid aside his bow and grasping his sword highly polished, with great impetuosity rushed at Chekitana.

sa: नागानीकेन महता ग्रसन्निव महीमिमाम्। दुःशासनो महाराज सव्यसाचिनमावृणोत्॥
en: 0 mighty monarch, Dushasana then surrounded Savyasachin with a mighty division of elephants that seemed to devour the whole earth.

sa: आक्रीडन्तो वहन्ति स्म सारङ्गशबला हयाः। धृष्टकेतुस्तु चेदीनामृशभोऽतिबलोदितः॥
en: Was borne by sportive steeds of the hue of antelopes, Dhristaketu, the foremost of the Chedis, endued with great prowess.

sa: कर्ण उवाच यस्मिन् धृतिर्बुद्धिपराक्रमौजः सत्यं स्मृतिर्वीरगुणाश्च सर्वे। अस्त्राणि दिव्यान्यथ संलतिहीं: प्रिया च वागनसूया च भीष्मे॥ सदा कृतज्ञे द्विजशत्रुघातके सनातनं चन्द्रमसीव लक्ष्म। स चेत् प्रशान्तः परवीरहन्ता मन्ये हतानेव च सर्ववीरान्॥
en: Karna said When that Bhishma, who was endued with resoluteness, intelligence, prowess, energy, truthfulness, self-control and with all the other attributes of a hero; who was proficient in the use of celestial weapons; in whom there were humility, bashfulness, sweet speech and harmlessness; who was always grateful, the slayer of the enemies of the twice-borns, in whom there resided all these virtues for ever that Bhishma the destroyer of hostilc heroes had obtained his quietus, I consider the remaining warriors as already slain.

sa: अकीर्ति चापि भूतानि कथयिष्यन्ति तेऽव्ययाम्। सम्भावितस्य चाकीर्तिमरणादतिरिच्यते॥
en: And all men will proclaim your everlasting infamy. To him, who is honoured, infamy is a greater (calamity) then death.

sa: प्रगृह्य विपुलं चापं ज्ञातिभिः परिवारितः। शूलमुद्गरहस्तैश्च नानाप्रहरणैरपि॥
en: Holding a massive bow and surrounded by his relations armed with bludgeons and mallets, and diverse other kinds of weapons.

sa: रथेनैकेन दुर्धर्षों युयुधानजनार्दनौ। जग्मतुः सहितौ वीरावर्जुनस्य निवेशनम्॥
en: Those two indomitable warriors, the heroes Yuyudhana and Janardana, riding on the same car, proceeded towards the abode of Arjuna.

sa: यस्त्विन्द्रियाणि मनसा नियम्यारभतेऽर्जुन। कर्मेन्द्रियैः कर्मयोगमसक्तः स विशिष्यते॥
en: But he, who restraining his senses by his mind, performs Karma-yoga by the organs of actions, is superior (to all).

sa: ततोऽनन्तरमेवासीद् भारद्वाजः प्रतापवान्। पुलिन्दैः पारदैश्चैव तथा क्षुद्रकमालवैः॥
en: Behind him came the son of Bharadvaja endued with prowess, being supported by the Pulindas, the Kshudrakas and the Malavas.

sa: तपोऽभ्युदीर्णं तपसैव बाध्यते बलं बलेनैव तथा मनस्विभिः। मनश्च मे शत्रुनिवारणे ध्रुवं स्वरक्षणे चाचलवद् व्यवस्थितम्॥
en: Great power, begot of austerities, should be opposed by ascetic wealth. So should the wise oppose might with might. My mind is decided upon withstanding the enemy and it is resolutely fixed upon ensuring the safety (of my own troops).

sa: पूर्णायतविसृष्टेन सम्यक् प्रणिहितेन च। ध्वजमेकेन विव्याध जाम्बूदनपरिष्कृतम्॥
en: With one arrow shot from his bow drawn to its fullest extent, he cut off (Bhishma's) standard adorned with gold,

sa: विपताकध्वच्छत्रा व्यश्वसूतायुधा रणे॥ व्यङ्गाङ्गावयवाः पेतुः क्षितौ क्षीणा:क्षितीश्वराः।
en: Deprived of their standards, flags, umbrellas, horses, drivers, weapons, armas and other limbs, the kings, weakened, fell down on earth.

sa: ततो जीमूतसंकाशान्नागादिन्द्र इव प्रभुः। अभ्यवर्षच्छरौघेण भगदत्तो धनंजयम्॥
en: Then staying on his elephant that resembled a mass of clouds, the mighty down-pour of arrows, like Indra showering rain.

sa: अस्यैवं वर्तमानस्य पुरुषस्याप्रमादिनः। अमित्राः संप्रसीदन्ति तथा मित्रीभवन्त्यपि॥
en: A person who carefully conducts himself in this way finds his every enemies shorn of hostility and converted into friends.

sa: तथा च गतिमन्तस्ते वासुदेवस्य वाजिनः। राजमार्गे नरैर्वृते॥
en: The steeds of Vasudeva, though swift in speed lost their motion, in the public road covered over by human beings.

sa: ते वयं नियतात्मानः पर्वतं गन्धमादनम्। प्रवेक्ष्यामो मिताहाराधनंजयदिदृक्षवः॥
en: Therefore with regulated diet and with subdued passions, we to the Gandamadana with the desire of seeing Dhananjaya. shall go

sa: यो दद्यादपरिक्लिष्टमध्वनि वर्तते। श्रान्तायदृष्टपूर्वाय तस्य पुण्यफलं महत्॥
en: He, who gives food freely to a fatigued way. farer, whom he has never seen before, obtains grcat virtuous merit.

sa: प्राच्छादयच्छितैर्बाणैर्महाराज शिखण्डिनम्। च च्छाद्यमानः समरे गौतमेन यशस्विना॥
en: Covered Shikhandin, Ogreat monarch, with sharpened arrows. (Thus) covered (with shafts) by the high-souled son of Goutama in that battle.

sa: ततो महति पर्यङ्के मणिकाञ्चनभूषिते। ददर्श कृष्णमासीनं नीलमेघसमद्युतिम्॥
en: He saw Krishna, of the hue of a blue cloud, seated on a large sofa bedecked with gold and gems.

sa: विबभौ सर्वतः श्लिष्टं सविद्युदिव तोयदः। पीतरक्तासितसितैर्वासोभिश्च सुवेष्टितः॥
en: Looked beautiful like a mighty cloud fringed with streaks of lightning. Attired beautifully in yellow, red, white and sable garments.

sa: ततो युधिष्ठिरः कर्णमदूरस्थं निवारितम्। अब्रवीत् परवीरनं क्रोधसंरक्तलोचनः॥
en: Thereupon beholding Karna, the slayer of hostile heroes, obstructed at a distance, an Yudhishthira, with eyes reddened with anger, said-

sa: अथाप्युपायं पश्येत दुःखस्य परिमोक्षणे। अशोचन्नारभेतैवं मुक्तश्चाव्यसनी भवेत्॥
en: Instead of gruinbling, one must try to find out the means by which he can be freed from all misery.

sa: असंशयं सर्वसमृद्धकामः क्षिप्रं प्रजाः पालयितासि सम्यक्। इमे वयं निग्रहणे कुरूणां यदि प्रतिज्ञा भवतः समाप्ता॥
en: It admits of no doubt that with all your desires gratified you will soon creditably govern your subjects. And when your promise (to spend twelve years in exile) will be fulfilled, we will try our utmost to chastise the Kurus."

sa: एतस्मिन्नेव काले सर्ववादित्रनिःस्वनः। बभूव तुमुल: शब्दस्त्वन्तरिक्षे दिवौकसाम्॥
en: At this time there arose in the firmament tremendous and dreadful sounds of all the musical instruments of the gods;

sa: धनानि येषां विपुलानि सन्ति नित्यं रमन्ते सुविभूषिताङ्गाः। तेषामयं शत्रुवरघ्न लोको नासौ सदा देहसुखे रतानाम्॥
en: They, that possess vast wealth, sport themselves every day richly adorning their persons (with ornaments and dresses). Such men, O destroyer of powerful enemies being addicted to physical enjoyment, attain to happiness in this world but not in the next.

sa: वहन्त्यो वारि बहुलं फेनोडुपपरिप्लुतम्। परिसस्रुर्महाशब्दाः प्रकर्षन्त्यो महीरुहान्॥
en: Carrying volumes of water and covered with large quantity of froth, they rushed down with tremendous roars uprooting many trees.

sa: चित्रसेनश्च भीमश्च सव्यसाची यमावपि। पृष्ट्वा कौशलमन्योन्यं रथेष्वेवारतस्थिरे॥
en: Chitrasena, Bhima and Arjuna and the twins then enquired after one another's welfare and sat down on their respective chariots.

sa: एवमभ्यर्चिताः सर्वे प्रयच्छन्ति शुभं नृणाम्। आयुर्वीर्यं च राजेन्द्र सम्यक्पूजानमस्कृताः॥ ऊर्ध्वं तु षोडशाद् वर्षाद् ये भवन्ति ग्रहा नृणाम् तानहं सम्प्रवक्ष्यामि नमस्कृत्य महेश्वरम्॥
en: O king of kings, when they are respected and honoured in due form, they bestow on men whatever is good for them and also valour and long life. Having made due salutation to the great god, I shall now describe to you the nature of those spirits that influence the destinies of men after they have attained their sixteenth year.

sa: ततः परमसंहष्टा सुनन्दा गृहमागमत्। दमयन्तीमुपादाय सखीभिः परिवारिता॥
en: Thereupon Sunanda, having received Damayanti with the greatest delight, conducted her into her own apartinents, attended by all her companions.

sa: वातेन कुन्त्यां बलवान् सुजात: शूरस्तरस्वी द्विषतां निहन्ता। सत्ये चधर्मे च रतः सदैव पराक्रमे शत्रुभिरप्रधृष्यः॥
en: But that mighty hero was begotten by Vayu in the womb of Kunti. He was heroic and courageous; that slayer of foes was ever devoted to virtue and truth. He was incapable of being vanquished by any enemy through prowess.

sa: उत्सृज्यध्वं महावीर्यान् धृतराष्ट्रसुतानिमान्। दारांश्चैषां विमुञ्चध्वं धर्मराजस्य शासनात्॥
en: Therefore let off all these mighty sons of Dhritarashtra. Let off also these ladies at the command of Dharmaraja (Yudhishthira).

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच ततो जग्राह शकुनिस्तानक्षानक्षतत्त्ववित्। जितमित्येव शकुनियुधिष्ठिरमभाषत॥
en: Vaishampayana said Thereupon Shakuni, well-skilled in dice, took up the dice and said to Yudhishthira, “Lo, I have won it".

sa: अयं सधर्मप्रभावो नरेन्द्रो धर्मेधृतः सत्यधृतिः प्रदाता। चलेद्धि राज्याच्च सुखाच्च पार्थो धर्मादपेतस्तु कथं विवर्धेत्॥ कथं नु भीष्मश्च कृपश्च विप्रो द्रोणश्च राजा च कुलस्य वृद्धः। प्रव्राज्य पार्थान् सुखमाप्नुवन्ति धिक् पापबुद्धीन् भरतप्रधानान्॥
en: Here is this lord of men born of Dharma himself, ever steady in the path of virtue, devoted to truthfulness and possessing a liberal heart, this son of Pritha who should give up his kingdom, but who would not swerve from the path of virtue. How is it that Bhishma, Kripa, Brahmana, Drona, the aged king (Dhritarashtra), the senior members of the (Kuru) race are all living happily after banishing the sons of Pritha? Fie to the viciousminded leaders of the Bharata race!

sa: न क्रियतामनुबन्धो नैष शक्यस्त्वया मृगोऽयं ग्रहीतुं यद्यपि ते रथे युक्तौ वाम्यौ स्यातामिति।।ततोऽब्रवीद् राजा सूतमाचक्ष्व मे वाम्यौ हन्मि च त्वामिति। स एवमुक्तो राजभयभीत: सूतो वामदेवशापभीतश्च सन् नाचख्यौ राज्ञे। ततः पुनः स राजा खङ्गमुद्यम्य शीघ्रं कथयस्वेति तमाह हनिय॑ त्वामिति। स तदाऽऽह राजभयभीतः सूतो वामदेवस्याश्चौ वाम्यौ मनोजवाविति॥
en: "Do not entertain such a purpose. This deer is incapable of being caught by you. If however Vami horses were yoked to your chariot, then you could have caught it.” Thereupon the king said to the charioteer. Tell me all about the Vami horses or else I shall kill you,” Having been thus addressed by the king, the charioteer became greatly frightened. He was afraid of the king, he was also afraid of the Vamadeva; and therefore he did not tell the king anything. Thereupon the king uplifting his sword again said to him. “Tell me soon or I will certainly kill you.” Being afraid of the king, the charioteer said, “Vami horses are those that belong to Vamadeva, they are as fleet as the mind.

sa: राजा दुर्योधनो नाम धृतराष्ट्रसुतो बली। विजिहीर्षुरिहायाति तदर्थमपसर्पत॥
en: “The powerful king named Duryodhana, the son of Dhritarashtra, has come here for sport. Therefore leave this place at once.”

sa: द्रौपद्युवाच इमं तु ते मार्गमपेतमोहं वक्ष्यामि चित्तग्रहणाय भर्तुः। अस्मिन् यथावत् सखि वर्तमाना भर्तारमाच्छेत्स्यसि कामिनीभ्यः॥
en: Draupadi said: I shall now point out to you a way for attracting the hearts of your husband which is free from deceit. O friend, by duly adopting it, you will be able to withdraw your husband from other women.

sa: यत्रानुवंशं भगवाञ्जामदग्न्यस्तथा जगौ। विश्वामित्रस्य तां दृष्ट्वा विभूतिमतिमानुषीम्॥
en: And where seeing the relics of Vishvamitra's superhuman power, Rama, the son of Jamadagni, recited the praises of his ancestor.

sa: सर्वमेतदपार्थं ते क्षिप्रं तौ सम्प्रसादय। श्रद्दधस्व मम ब्रह्मन् नान्यथा कर्तुमर्हसि। गम्यतामद्य विप्रर्षे श्रेयस्ते कथयाम्यहम्॥
en: But all has become in vain, therefore soon go back to console your parents. Have regard for my words and do not act in any other way. I tell you what is good for you, O Brahmana return even today.

sa: हिमवन्तमतिक्रम्य गन्धमादनमेव च। अत्यक्रामत् स दुर्गाणि दिवारात्रमतन्द्रितः॥
en: Having cross the Himalayas and also the Gandhamadana and many other uneven and dangerous passes by walking day and night.

sa: चकार सज्यं गाण्डीवं वज्रनिष्पेषगौरवम्। निमेषान्तरमात्रेण तथैव विजयोऽर्जुनः॥
en: Within a twinkle of an eye the ever victorious Arjuna stringed the Gandiva (bow) of the force of the thunder.

sa: रुद्रेणाग्नि समाविश्य स्वाहामाविश्य चोमया। हितार्थं सर्वलोकानां जातस्त्वमपराजितः॥
en: Rudra with Agni and Uma and with Svaha have combined to make you invincible for the good of the world.

sa: एतत् कार्यं महाबाहो येनाहं नागमं तदा। श्रुत्वैव हास्तिनपुरं द्यूतं चाविनयोत्थितम्। द्रुतमागतवान् युष्मान् द्रष्टुकामः सुदुःखितान्॥
en: It is for this, O mighty-armed hero, that I could not come to you. But no sooner I heard of the unfair gambling at Hastinapur than I have come here to see you who have been thus sunk in calamity.

sa: दहेयं थेन संग्रमे दानवान् राक्षसांस्तथा। भूतानि च पिशाचाश्च गन्धर्वानथ पन्नगान्॥ यस्मिञ्छूलसहस्राणि गदाश्चोचप्रदर्शनाः। शराश्चाशीविषाकारा: सम्भवन्त्यनुमन्त्रिते॥
en: The weapon by which I may destroy in battle the Danavas, the Rakshasas, the evil spirits, the Pishachas, the Gandharvas and the Nagas. The weapon which when hurled with Mantras produces thousands of darts, maces and virulently poisonous snake-like arrows.

sa: द्रौपदीमार्षिणाय सम्प्रधार्य महारथाः। सहिताः सायुधाः शूराः शैलमारुरुहुस्तदा।॥
en: Thereupon leaving Draupadi under the care of Arstisena and furnished with weapons, those heroes and mighty car-warriors ascended the mountain.

sa: गदामुसलशक्त्याद्यैर्वृतः प्रहरणोत्तमैः। पट्टिशं त्वन्वगाद् राजञ्छनं रौद्रं महाप्रभम्॥
en: By mace, balls, clubs and other excellent weapons. O king, Pattisha was followed by the greatly effulgent umbrella of Rudra.

sa: सत्रे समृद्धेऽतिरथस्य राज्ञो वेदीतलादुत्पतिता सुता या। सेयं वने वासमिमं सुदुःखं कथं सहत्यद्य सती सुखार्हा॥
en: This princess (Draupadi), the daughter of a king, who is a great car-warrior, rose from the sacrificial altar. She was always accustomed to a life of comfort and ease. How is she now enduring the miserable life in the forest?

sa: अव्याधिजं कटुजं तीक्ष्णमुष्णं यशोमुषं परुषं पूतिगन्धि। सतां पेयं यन्न पिबन्त्यसन्तो मन्युं महाराज पिब प्रशाम्य॥
en: O great king, drink that which is drunk by the honest and shunned by the dishonest, that (drink of) humility which is like a medicine that is bitter, pungent, burning, unintoxicating, disagreeable and revolting. Drinking it (humility), regain your sobriety.

sa: निहतान् दानवान् दृष्ट्वा त्रिदशा मुनिपुङ्गवम्। तुष्टुवुर्विविधैर्वाक्यैरिदं वचनमब्रुवन्॥
en: Seeing the Danavas destroyed, the celestials gratified that foremost of Rishis (Agastya) with various speeches; and they then thus spoke,

sa: पापीयान् स हि शूद्रेभ्यस्तस्करेभ्यो विशिष्यते। शास्त्रातिगो मन्दबुद्धिर्योधर्ममभिशङ्कते॥
en: That vicious-minded one, who transgresses the scriptures and doubts virtue is regarded as lower even than the Shudras and robbers.

sa: तैरियं पृथिवीं सर्वा सपर्वतवनाकरा। आपूर्यते महाराज सलिलौघपरिप्लुता॥
en: O great king, those masses of clouds then flood with water the whole earth with her mountains, forests and mines.

sa: पाण्डुरेणातपत्रेण ध्रियमाणेन मूर्धनि। शुशुभे तारकाराजः सितमभ्रमिव स्थितः॥
en: And the white umbrella being held over his head he shone like the moon in the midst of fleecy clouds.

sa: याज्ञसेन्याः परामृद्धिं दृष्ट्वा प्रज्वलितामिव। स्नुषास्ता धृतराष्ट्रस्य नातिप्रमनसोऽभवन्॥
en: Seeing the blazing and splendid beauty and prosperity of Yajnaseni (Draupadi), Dhritarashtra's daughters-in-law were filled with jealousy and became cheerless.

sa: अश्वमेधस्य यत् पुण्यं तन्मासेनाधिगच्छति। सर्वतीर्थवरे चैव यो वसेत महाह्रदे॥ न दुर्गतिमवाणोति विन्देद् बहु सुवर्णकम्।
en: Obtains in one month without doubt the virtue which is the fruit of Ashvamedha (sacrifice). He who lives in that foremost of all Tirthas, called Mahahrada. Never meets with any calamity and obtains the fruits of giving away much gold.

sa: सुखोचितमदुःखाहँ दुरात्मा ससुहृद्गणः। ईदृशं दुःखमानीय मोदते पापपूरुषः॥
en: Having brought you, who are used to happiness, to such a miserable plight that vicious-souled wretch delights with his friends.

sa: त्र गन्तुमिच्छामि कवे दुरोदरम्। इष्टो हि पुत्रस्य पिता सदैव तदस्मि कर्ता विदुरात्थ मां यथा॥
en: O leaned man, I do not desire to engage in gambling at the command of king Dhritarashtra, for a father always Wishes to benefit his son. You are our master, OVidura, tell me what is proper (for us to do).

sa: अतिक्रान्तास्तु वेगेन जगामानुसृतः शनैः। ततोऽमरवरप्रख्यो भीमसेनो महाबलः॥
en: (But he) overtaken them with speed, leisurely pursued them. Then the highly powerful Bhimasena, resembling the lord of the gods,

sa: त्रिशिखां भृकुटीं कृत्वा सृक्किणी परिसंलहन्॥ उद्वीक्ष्य सुरथं रोषाद् धनुर्ध्यामवमृज्य च। मुमोच तीक्ष्णं नाराचं यमदण्डोपमद्युतिम्॥
en: Contracting his eye brow into three lines and licking the corners of his inouth with his tongue, he looked at Suratha in anger and then touched his bowstring and shot a keen clothyard shaft resembling the dreadful rod of Death.

sa: तस्मिन् निपतिते वीरे पत्यौ सर्वमहीक्षिताम्। महास्वना पुनर्दीप्ता सनिर्घाता भयंकरी॥ पपात चोल्का महती पतिते पृथिवीपतौ।
en: Upon the fall of that hero who was the head of all kings, fierce and fiery winds blew with a loud noise and with thunder falling frequently. When that lord of Earth fell, large meteors dropped down from the welkin.

sa: तानर्जुनः प्रत्यगृह्णात् सहदेवजये धृतः। भीमसेनश्च तेजस्वी क्रुद्धाशीविषदर्शनः॥
en: Resolved to help Sahadeva in his victory, the energetic Arjuna and Bhimasena, resembling an infuriated venomous serpent, received those warriors.

sa: अत्राप्युदाहरन्तीममितिहासं पुरातनम्। मुनिः कालकवृक्षीयः कौसल्यं यदुवाच ह॥
en: Regarding it an old story also is cited of what the sage Kalakavrikshiya har said to the king of Koshala.

sa: आलोपालाविपालेभ्यो द्रवन्तो नगरं प्रति। ययुर्मनुष्याः सम्भ्रान्ता भीमसेनभयार्दिताः॥
en: The very cowherds and shepherds and common men, stricken with panic for the fear of Bhimasena, fled towards the city.

sa: त्रिपादं चायुतशतैर्जघान दशभिर्वृतम्। ह्रदोदरं निखर्वैश्च वृतं दशभिरीश्वरः॥
en: The powerful Skanda then over-powered Hradodara, who encircled by Nikharvas of Daityas, with all his followers armed with various weapons.

sa: आशयाचोदपानाश्च प्रभूतसलिलाकराः। निरोद्धव्याः सदा राज्ञा क्षीरिणश्च महीरुहाः॥
en: He should multiply the number of tanks and wells containing large quantities of water, and should protect all shady trees.

sa: बाणशब्दरवाश्चापि सिंहनादाश्च पुष्कलाः। शङ्खशब्दाश्च शूराणां दारुणः समपद्यत॥
en: The sound of arrows and the loud leonine roars and the blare of conchs, of heroic warriors were heard there,

sa: तस्याश्वसादीन् सुबहूंस्ते निहत्य शितैः शरैः॥ समभ्यधावंस्त्वरितास्तत्र युद्धमभून्महत्।
en: Having killed with sharp arrows his cavalry and elephants they attacked Shakuni himself upon which a great encounter took place.

sa: अध्यायानां सहस्रेण काव्यः संक्षेपमब्रवीत्। तच्छास्त्रममितप्रज्ञो योगाचार्यो महायशाः॥
en: Next, the famous teacher of Yoga, Kavi of unlimited wisdom, abridged it further into a work of a thousand chapters.

sa: अधर्मः क्षत्रियस्यैष यच्छय्यामरणं भवेत्। विसृजश्लेष्ममूत्राणि कृपणं परिदेवयन्॥
en: Quiet death on a bed, after throwing out phlegm and urine and uttering piteous cries, is sinful for a Kshatriya.

sa: ततः प्रसृततोयं तं प्रसमीक्ष्य जलाशयम्। बबन्धुर्विविधैर्योगैर्मत्स्यान् मत्स्योपजीविनः॥
en: Seeing that all the water had been drawn out, the fishermen shut in the fishes which remained by various means.

sa: सर्वलोकमहेष्वासौ वृषभौ सर्वधन्विनाम्। आमुक्तकवचौ कृष्णौ लोकमध्ये विचेरतुः॥
en: Those two foremost of bowinen in all the worlds, viz., the two Krishnas clad in mail, are looking highly beautiful.

sa: विलपन्त्यो रुदत्यश्च धावमानास्ततस्ततः। शोकेनोपहतज्ञानाः कर्तव्यं न प्रजज्ञिरे॥
en: Weeping and crying and running here and there, deprived of their senses by sorrow, they knew not what to do.

sa: अर्जुन उवाच दण्डः शास्ति प्रजाः सर्वा दण्ड एवाभिरक्षति। दण्डः सुप्तेषु जागर्ति दण्डं धर्म विदुर्बुधाः॥
en: Arjuna said (A king with) the rod of chastisement sways all subjects and protects them. The rod of chastisement is awake when all else is under sleep. For this, the wise have designated the rod of chastisement as Righteousness itself.

sa: ततो मुहूर्तमाश्वस्य दुर्योधनमुपस्थितम्। वेगेनाभ्यपद् राजन् भीमसेनः प्रतापवान्॥
en: Having taken rest for a little while, the brave Bhimasena rushed furiously, O king, at Duryodhana who was standing near.

sa: अथ तस्यामनावृष्ट्यामतीतायां महर्षयः॥ अन्योन्यं परिपप्रच्छुः पुनः स्वाध्यायकारणात्।
en: After the termination of that twelve years' drought the great Rishis requested one another to deliver discourses on the Vedas.

sa: यदि गुह्यं न वो नित्यं तदा प्रब्रूत मा चिरम्। न गुह्यं श्रोतुमिच्छामि युष्मद्भयो द्विजसत्तमाः॥
en: If the subject be one which you can properly describe, then tell me all about it forthwith. I do not wish, ye foremost of the twice-born, to hear anything from you be a mystery and improper to describe. that may

sa: स्तूर्ण रथेनापकृतध्वजेन। दुर्योधनस्यान्तिकमेत्य राजन् सबाष्पदुःखाद् वचनं बभाषे॥
en: Approaching Duryodhana speedily on that car devested of standard of the king of Madras, with an aggrieved heart, said sorrowfully.

sa: ययुर्देवा यथाकामं गन्धर्वाप्सरसस्तथा॥ कथयन्तोऽद्भुतं युद्धं सुतयोस्तव भारत।
en: The gods and Gandharvas went away to their wished-for regions, taking and discoursing on that wonderful battle between your sons.

sa: दानमध्ययनं यज्ञं प्रजानां परिपालनम्। धर्ममेतदधर्मं वा जन्मनैवाभ्यजायथाः॥
en: Whether gifts, study, sacrifices and the protection of subjects, virtuous of sinful you are born to practise and perform them.

sa: ततो राजा मुचुकुन्दः सोऽन्वशासद् वसुन्धराम्। बाहुवीर्यार्जितां सम्यक्षत्रधर्ममनुव्रतः॥
en: King Muchukunda, devoted to Kshatriya duties, continued to rule the entire Earth acquired by the power of his own arms.

sa: ममन्थुर्दक्षिणं चोरुमृषयस्तस्य मन्त्रतः। ततोऽस्य विकृतो जज्ञे ह्रस्वाङ्गः पुरुषो भुवि॥ दग्धस्थूणाप्रतीकाशो रक्ताक्षः कृष्णमूर्धजः। निषीदेत्येवमूचुस्तमृषयो ब्रह्मवादिनः॥
en: Uttering Mantras all the while, those Rishis pierced the right thigh of Vena. Thereupon, from that thigh, sprang a short-limbed person on earth, resembling a charred brand, having blood-red eyes and black hair. Those Brahmavadins said to him,-Nishida (sit) here.

sa: अत्राप्युदाहरन्तीममितिहासं पुरातनम्। विश्वामित्रस्य संवादं चाण्डालस्य च पक्कणे॥
en: Regarding it is cited the old story of the conversation between Vishvamitra and the Chandala in a village of Chandalas.

sa: ततः शल्यो रणे क्रुद्धः पीने वक्षसि तोमरम्॥ निचखान नदन वीरो वर्म भित्वा च सोऽभ्ययात्।
en: Then heroic Shalya, worked up with wrath, in that battle, hurled a lance at the broad chest of Bhima and sent fourth a loud war-cry. That lance, cutting through the cost of mail of Pandu's son, entered into his person.

sa: स पपात नरव्याघ्रो वसुधामनुनादयन्। भग्नोरुर्भीमसेनेन पुत्रस्तव महीपते॥
en: That foremost of men, viz., your son after his thighs had been broken by Bhimasena, fell down resounding the Earth.

sa: ततो गिरः पुरुषवरस्तवान्विता द्विजेरिता: पथि सुमनाः स शुश्रुवे। कृताञ्जलिं प्रणतमथापरं जनं स केशिहा मुदितमनाभ्यनन्दत॥
en: That foremost of men, as he went on, cheerfully listened to the laudatory, speeches uttered by the Brahmanas. The destroyer of Keshi, with a cheerful heart, saluted the people waiting by the road side with joined hands and bent heads.

sa: अवतीर्य रथेभ्यस्तु त्वरमाणा महारथाः। ददृशुद्रौपदी कृष्णामार्तामार्ततराः स्वयम्॥
en: Quickly getting down from their cars, those great car-warriors, themselves much more afflicted, saw Draupada's daughter Krishna stricken with misery.

sa: मानसानां पुनर्योनिर्दुःखानां चित्तविभ्रमः। अनिष्टोपनिपातो वा तृतीयं नोपपद्यते॥
en: The causes of all mental sorrow are twofold viz., delusion of the mind and distress. No third cause is there.

sa: द्रोणं दुपदपुत्रेण निहतं मधुसूदन। कृपी कृपणमन्वास्ते दुःखोपहतचेतना॥
en: Senseless with sorrow, Kripi sorrowfully attends, O destroyer of Madhu, on that Drona who has been killed by Draupada's son.

sa: अस्मांस्तु पुनरासाद्य लब्धलक्षा दुरासदाः। शरासनानि धुन्वन्तः शरवर्षैरवाकिरन्॥
en: The invincible and sure-armed Pandavas, once more coming against us, shook their bows and enshrouded us with showers of arrows.

sa: नास्तिकाश्रद्दधानेषु पुरुषेषु कदाचन। दम्भद्वेषप्रधानेषु विधिरेष न दृश्यते॥
en: They are not for atheists or those that have no faith, or those who are full of pride and malice.

sa: त्रितः स श्रेष्ठतां प्राप यथैवास्य पिता तथा।
en: Amongst them however, Trita, by his acts and Vedic studies, O king, became the foremost, even like his father Gautama.

sa: विरथं तं समालक्ष्य विशिखैोमवाहिभिः। अवाकिरदमेयात्मा दर्शयन् पाणिलाघवम्॥
en: Beholding him carless and displaying the lightness of his hand the great son of Pandu covered him with winged arrows.

sa: आजगामाश्रमं तस्यास्त्रिदशाधिपतिः प्रभुः। आस्थाय रूपं विप्रर्वसिष्ठस्य महात्मनः॥
en: The powerful Lord of the celestials then came to that hermitage, having assumed the form of the great Rishi Vashishtha.

sa: क्रोधेन महताऽऽविष्टो धर्मात्मा वै प्रतापवान्। पुरा हि नैमिषीयाणां सत्रे द्वादशवार्षिके॥ वृत्ते विश्वाजितोऽन्ते वै पञ्चालानृषयोऽगमन्।
en: Formerly the Rishis, living in the Naimisha forest, had celebrated a sacrifice extending over twelve years. In the course of that sacrifice, after a particular one called Vishvajit had been completed, the Rishis started for the country of the Panchalas.

sa: देवतातिथिभिश्चैव पितृभिश्चैव पार्थिव। सर्वरेतैः परित्यक्तः परिव्रजसि निष्क्रियः॥
en: Alas forsaken by gods, guests, and Pitris, you live like a wandering mendicant, o king, having cast off all action.

sa: दुर्योधनोऽपि राजेन्द्र पाञ्चाल्यस्योत्तमौजसः। जघान चतुरोऽस्याश्वानुभौ तौ पाणिसारथी॥
en: Duryodhana also, O foremost of kings, slew the four steeds of the Panchala prince Uttamoujas and also both this Parshni-drives.

sa: नादयन् रथघोषेण कम्पयन्निव मेदिनीम्। अभ्यवर्तत पुत्रस्ते पाण्डवानामनीकिनीम्॥
en: Causing the earth to tremble and resound with the rattle of his car, your son rushed against the Pandava army.

sa: षट्त्रिंशद्भिस्ततो भल्लैर्निशितैस्तिग्मतेजनैः। व्यधमत् कवचं क्रुद्धः सूतपुत्रस्य पाण्डवः॥
en: Then Pandu's son, excited with rage cut-off the armour of Suta's son with thirty-six Vallas of great sharpness and energy.

sa: ततः शङ्खसहस्राणि भेरीणामयुतानि च। अवादयन्त संहृष्टाः कुरुपाण्डवसैनिकाः॥
en: Then the Kuru and the Pandava troops filled with delight struck up ten thousand Bheris and blew a thousand conches.

sa: युधामन्यु त्रिभिः षडभिरुत्तमौजसमाहवे। अन्यांश्च सैनिकान् विद्ध्वा युधिष्ठिरमुपाद्रवत्॥
en: Yudhamanu with three and Uttamanja with six (arrows) in that battle. (Similarly) piercing many other soldiers (he) rushed against Yudhishthira.

sa: ततो घटोत्कचः खङ्गमुद्धृत्याद्भुतदर्शनम्॥ रौद्रस्य काशिद्ध शिरो भीमं विकृतदर्शनम्। स्फुरतस्तस्य समरे नदतश्चातिभैरवम्॥ निचकर्त महाराज शत्रोरमितविक्रमः।
en: Then with a sword of beautiful appearance, Ghatotkacha of infinite prowess cut-off, 0 king, from the trunk of his fierce and mighty foe, his terrible head that was even then uttering Creadful roars and that looked frightful, O mighty monarch.

sa: ततोऽस्य निशितैर्बाणैः सुमुक्तैरन्तकोपमैः। हयांश्चकार निर्देहानुभौ च पार्णिसारथी॥
en: Then with sharp arrows, resembling Death and duly discharged, Arjuna cut to pieces Duryodhana's horses and his two Parshni. drivers.

sa: अभाग्यस्येव संकल्पस्तन्मोघमपतद् भुवि। घटोत्कचस्ततस्तूर्णं दृष्ट्वा चक्रं निपातितम्॥
en: If fell down on the ground like the purposes of an unlucky person. Seeing his wheel cut down, Ghatotkacha speedily.

sa: दुर्मदस्तु ततो यानं दुष्कर्णस्यावचक्रमे। तावेकरथमारूढौ भ्रातरौ परतापनौ॥
en: Durmada then got to the car of Duskarna. Those two brothers, the tormentors of foes, mounted on the same car.

sa: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे चैनं श्रुतकीर्तिर्महायशाः। नवत्या जगतीपालं छादयामास पत्रिभिः॥
en: During this interval, the highly famous Shrutakirtin closed this ruler of the earth (his insensible foe) with ninety different shafts.

sa: दुर्योधन उवाच भूय एव तु मद्रेश यत्ते वक्ष्यामि तच्छृणु। यथा पुरावृत्तमिदं युद्धे देवासुरे विभो॥
en: Duryodhana said Do you. again, O chief of the Madras, O lord, hear all that I will relate to you, namely what had taken place in the days of old in the great war between the celestials and the Asuras.

sa: एतच्छुत्वा तु वचनं प्रतिगृह्य च सर्वशः॥ रामः कृतस्वस्त्ययनः प्रययौ दानवान् प्रति। अब्रवीद् देवशāस्तान् महादर्पबलान्वितान्॥
en: Hearing these words and also accepting them in all ways, Rama performed all the propitiatory ceremonies; as also he advanced against the Danavas. Then he addressed those enemies of the celestials, who were possessed of insensibility, pride and enormous strength,

sa: संजय उवाच एवमुक्त्वार्जुनो बाणमभिमन्त्र्य व्यकर्षयत्॥ मानवास्त्रेण मानार्हस्तीक्ष्णावरणभेदिना!
en: Sanjaya said Having thus spoken, Arjuna inspired some shafts with mantras and then began to draw them on the bow-string.

sa: नानारूपाः प्राणाहरा: शरा गाण्डीवचोदिताः॥ अलातौल्काशनिप्रख्यास्तव सैन्यं विनिर्दहन्।
en: Lots of deadly, burning and meteor-like shots, coming like thunder-bolts out of the Gandiva, began to burn down your troops.

sa: इत्येवमुक्त्वा बीभत्सुर्देवदत्तमथाधमत्। पाञ्चजन्यं च कृष्णोऽपि पूरयन्निव रोदसी॥
en: Having said this Vibhatsu blew his Devadatta conch and Krishna his Panchajanya filling the earth and sky with the blare.

sa: अल्पावशेषो दिवसो नृवीर विघातयस्वाद्य रिपुं शरौघैः। दिनक्षयं प्राप्य नरप्रवीर ध्रुवोहि नः कर्ण जयो भविष्यति॥
en: O foremost hero among men, very little remains of the day. Thwart the enemy now with the waves of your arrows. O foremost of men, if we can safely reach the expire of the day, victory will certainly be ours.

sa: वृद्धौ च तौ महेष्वासौ सापेक्षौ च धनंजये। मानितौ च मया वीरौ राधेय वचनात् तव॥
en: Indeed, those two mighty bowmen were very old; and they were favourable disposed and you towards Dhananjaya. In despite thereof, O son of Radha, those two heroes were selected by me as the generalissimo of my army at your word.

sa: कर्णोऽपि द्विषतां हन्ता छादयामास फाल्गुनम्। सायकैर्बहुसाहस्रैः कृतप्रतिकृतेप्सया॥
en: Karna also that slayer of foes, desirous of counteracting the feats of his antagonist, covered Phalguna with thousands of arrows.

sa: कृपश्च कृतवर्मा च शकुनिश्चापि सौबलः॥ हृष्टसेनाः सुसंरब्धा रथानीकप्रहारिणः। कोसलैः काश्यमत्स्यैश्च कारुषैः केकयैरपि॥ शूरसेनैः शूरवरैर्युयुधुर्युद्धदुर्मदाः।
en: Kripa, Kritavarma, Shakuni, the son of Subala, with cheerful soldiers, all greatly worked up with anger and capable of striking the car-warriors fought with Kosalas, the Kachis, Matsyas, Karushas, Kekayas and Surasenas all of whom were highly terrible in battle.

sa: शिरांस्यपातयचापि पञ्चालानां महामृधे। तथैव परिघाकारान् बाहून् कनकभूषणान्॥
en: He then cut-off, in that great battle, innumerable heads of Panchala warriors as also their mace-like arms wearing golden ornaments.

sa: त्रिगर्मीश्चोदयामास युयुधानस्थं प्रति। तेऽगच्छन् युयुधानस्य समीपं क्रूरकर्मणः।
en: Then three thousand warriors of the Trigaratta clan versed in battling and of cruel deeds, reaching the car of Yuyudhana.

sa: दुःशासनः सौबलश्च गजानीकेन पाण्डवम्। महता परिवार्यैव क्षुद्रकैरभ्याताडयत्॥
en: With a huge elephant force Dushasana and Subala's son surrounded Pandu's son and began to assail him with small arrows.

sa: तदप्यस्य शितैर्भल्लैश्चिच्छेद कुरुपुङ्गवः। ततोऽब्रवीद् वासुदेवः कुन्तीपुत्रं युधिष्ठिरम्॥
en: The best of the Kurus cut-off that also with keen and broad-headed shaft, Then Vasudeva, addressed Yudhishthira, the son of

sa: सूतपुत्रोऽपि समरेपञ्चालन् केकयांस्तथा। सृञ्जयांश्च महेष्वासान् निजधान सहस्रशः॥
en: The Suta's son too began to slay by thousands the mighty bowmen of the Panchalas, the Kaikeyas and the Srinjayas.

sa: संनिवार्यात्मनो नागं क्षेमधूर्तिः प्रतापवान्। विध्याधाभिद्रुतं बाणैर्भीमसेनस्य कुञ्जरम्॥
en: Kshemadhurti of immense energy having checked his own elephant, pierced with his arrows the elephant of Bhimasena pursuing his own.

sa: हत्वा विंशतिसाहस्रान् क्षत्रियानरिमर्दनः। दशायुतानि करिणामवधीद् विशिखैः शितैः॥
en: Then that crusher of foes having slain twenty thousand Kshatriyas, slew another hundred thousands with whetted shafts of keen points.

sa: तमधर्मेण धर्मिष्ठं धृष्टद्युम्नेन संयुगे। श्रुत्वा निहतमाचार्यमश्वत्थामा किमब्रवीत्॥
en: Hearing that the righteous preceptor has been slain in battle by unfair means by Dhristadyumna what indeed did Ashvatthaman sky?

sa: दुर्योधनस्तेन तथा पूर्वमेवादितः शरैः। शैनेयं दशभिर्बाणैः प्रत्यविध्यदमर्पितः॥
en: Duryodhana then pierced as before with those arrows of Shini's grandsons, angrily pierced the latter with ten shafts in return.

sa: सुभगो भानुदत्तश्च शूराः पञ्च महारथाः॥ अभिद्रुत्य शरैस्तीक्षणैर्भीमसेनमताडयन्।
en: Rushing against Bhimasena, oppressed him with keen darts. Afflicted with those shafts like a mountain with torrents of rain, he.

sa: धृष्टद्युम्नस्तथा राजन् गभस्तिभिरिवांशुमान्। बभौ प्रच्छादयन्नाशाः शरजालैः समन्ततः॥
en: O king, discharging numerous shafts on all sides, Dhristadyumna at that time appeared beautiful like the sun of myriad rays.

sa: कान्त्या शशाङ्कस्य जवेन वायोः स्थैर्येण मेरोः क्षमया पृथिव्याः। सूर्यस्य भासा धनदस्य लक्ष्म्या शौर्येण शक्रस्य बलेन विष्णोः॥ तुल्यो महात्मा तव कुन्ति पुत्रो जातोऽदितेर्विष्णुरिवारिहन्ता। स्वेषां जयाय द्विषतां वधाय ख्यातोऽमितौजाः कुलतन्तुकर्ता॥
en: O Kunti, this magnanimous son of yours will be handsome like the Soma, swift like the Wind, patient like Sumeru, forbearing like the Earth, effulgent like Sun. wealthy like Kubera, valiant and powerful like Vishnu. This son of yours, even like Aditi's son Vishnu, the slayer of foes, has taken his being in order to bring victory to his kins and deal destruction to the enemies. This boy of indomitable valour will be far-famed and the founder of a dynasty.'

sa: ते शरैरग्निसंकाशैस्तोमरैश्च महाधनैः। शस्त्रैश्च विविधै राजन् द्रोणमेकमवाकिरन्॥
en: They then began to pour upon Drona darts resembling fire, thick showers of Tomaras and numerous other weapons, O king.

sa: भूयश्चाञ्जलिकेनाथ मार्गणेन महाप्रभम्। द्रौणिहस्तस्थितं चापं चिच्छेदाशु घटोत्कचः॥
en: Again by means of a broad-headed shaft, Ghatotkacha soon cut-off that highly lustrous bow wielded by the son of Drona.

sa: बृहत्क्षत्रे हते राजन् केकयानां महारथे। शैशुपालिरभिक्रुद्धो यन्तारमिदमब्रवीत्॥
en: When Brihatkshatra that mighty car-warrior was thus slain, O king the son of Sisupala highly enraged addressing his charioteer said-

sa: तेन संचोद्यमानस्तु ततस्तांस्तुरगोत्तमान्। सूत: संचोदयामास युयुधानस्थं प्रति॥ ततो दुर्योधनः क्रुद्धो दृढधन्वा जितक्कमः। शीघ्रहस्तश्चित्रयोधी युयुधानमुपाद्रवत्॥
en: Then inspired by him that charioteer proceeded those excellent horses to the car of Yuyudhana. Then that resolute bowman that indefatigable warrior, king Duryodhana versed in various modes of warfare and endued with great lightness of hands, rushed upon Yuyudhana.

sa: उत्थितान्यगणेयानि कबन्धानि समन्ततः। अदृश्यन्त महाराज तस्मिन् परमसंकुले॥
en: In that extremely terrible encounter, () mighty monarch, thousands of headless trunks were seen to rise up from the ground.

sa: प्राद्रवतंस्तुरगास्ते तु शरवेगप्रपीडिताः। ततोऽभून्निनदो घोरस्तव सैन्यस्य भारत॥
en: Assailed with weapons the horses ran away on all sides. There then took place a great havoc of your soldiers.

sa: ताडितो भीमसेनेन क्रोधादारक्तलोचनः। विहसन्निव राधेयो वाक्यमेतदुवाच ह॥
en: Stuck by Bhimasena, the son of Radha with his eyes red in rage smilingly spoke these words to the former.

sa: दैवमस्य ध्रुवं तत्र साहाय्यायोपद्यते। व्यवसायद्वितीयोऽहं मनसा भारमुद्वहन्॥
en: Is surely helped by fate in carrying out his purposes, If resolving in my mind to bear a (great) burden.

sa: तव पुत्रास्ततः कर्ण सबला भरतर्षभ। परिवब्रुर्महात्मानं क्षिप्रमाहवसोभिनम्॥
en: O best of Bharata race, the Dhritarashtras, without losing time, surrounded the noble Karna, who was the best of warriors.

sa: ततस्तं शरवर्षेण महता समवाकिरत्। व्यशातयश्च संक्रुद्धो धृष्टद्युम्नममर्षणम्॥
en: Then he covered Dhristadyumna with a thick shower of arrows and filled with rage began to mangle his vindictive antagonist.

sa: सर्वशब्दानतिक्रम्य पूरयामास रोदसी। तस्मिंस्तथा वर्तमाने दारुणे नादसंकुले॥
en: Surpassing all other sounds filled the welkin and the earth. And when the fierce and dreadful sound was still continuing.

sa: युधिष्ठिरस्तु त्वरितो द्रोणशिष्यो महारथः॥ अब्रवीद् द्रोणपुत्राय रोषमर्षसमन्वितः।
en: Then the great car-warrior Yudhishthira being enraged and filled with revengeful spirit thus addressed the son of Drona in a

sa: विस्फार्य सुमहचापं ततश्चाधिरथिवृषः। पञ्चलान् पुनराधावत् पश्यतः सव्यसाचिनाः॥
en: Then Vrisha-the son of Adirath, drawing his great bow, again rushed towards the Panchalas before the very face of Savyasachin.

sa: ततः प्रादुश्चकारासमस्रमार्गविशारदः। ऐन्द्रं पाशुपतं त्वाष्ट्र वायव्यमथ वारुणम्॥
en: Then that foremost of all knowers of weapons, began to invoke into existence, Aindra, Pasupata, Sashtra, Vayavya and Varuna weapons.

sa: ततश्चतुर्भिश्च शरैस्तूर्णं तांस्तुरगोत्तमान्। समीपं प्रेषयामास प्रेतराजस्य भारत॥
en: Then with four darts he speedily sent before the lord of the departed spirit the four excellent horses (of Somadatta).

sa: रक्तचन्दनसंदिग्धौ मणिहेमविभूषितौ॥ बाहू व्यत्यक्षिपत् कर्णः परमास्त्रं विदर्शयन्।
en: Beautiful bows shone in the arms of Karna of the colour of crimson sandal and adorned with gold and jewels.

sa: अभ्यद्रवन्त वेगेन कुम्भयोनिवधेप्सया। आगच्छतस्तान् सहसा सर्वोद्योगेन पाण्डवान्॥
en: Assailed the pot-born Drona with a view to defeat him. Then as the Pandavas rushed with great impetuosity and force.

sa: हस्तिदन्तत्सरून् खङ्गान् जातरूपरिष्कृतान्। वर्माणि चापविद्धानि रुक्मगर्भाणि भारत॥
en: O Bharata! gold studded swords with ivory handles and gold studded shields are also thrown carelessly on the ground here.

sa: यथा ह्यस्य भुजौ पीनौ नागराजकरोपमौ॥ वक्षः पश्य विशालं च सर्वशत्रुनिबर्हणम्। न त्वेष प्राकृतः कश्चित् कर्णो वैकर्तनो वृषः। महात्मा ह्येष राजेन्द्र रामशिष्यः प्रतापवान्॥
en: O monarch, Indeed, his two arms are very massive; and they are like the trunk of the prince of elephants. Do you behold his broad chest, which is powerful enough to resist all sorts of enemies. This Karna, the son of Vikartana, can never be an ordinary individual. O lord of kings, this high-souled disciple of Rama is really a very powerful warrior.

sa: बाणजालं दिविच्छन्नं स्वर्णजालविभूषितम्। शुशुभे भरतश्रेष्ठ वितानमिव धिष्ठितम्॥
en: The sky being covered with a net-work of golden arrows it appeared as if a canopy had been spread there.

sa: अथाद्रिशृङ्गमादाय हनुमान् मारुतात्मजः। अभिद्रुत्याददे प्राणान् वलावेगस्य रक्षसः॥
en: Then Hanuman, the son of Pavana, taking up a mountain-peak rushed at and took the life of, the Rakshasa Vajravega.

sa: युधिष्ठिरः साधुनैवाभ्युपेयो मा वो वधीदर्जुनो देवगुप्तः। राज्यं दद्ध्वं धर्मराजस्य तूर्णं याचध्वं वै पाण्डवं लोकवीरम्॥
en: Yudhishthira should be approached by an honourable man, let not Arjuna, protected by the gods, kill you and the king of virtue the son of Pandu-that hero among men should be forthwith asked to accept the kingdom surrender to him.

sa: जहीमान् राक्षसान् पापानात्मनः प्रतिरूपकान्। जधान रामस्तांश्चान्यानात्मनः प्रतिरूपकान्॥
en: "Kill those wicked-souled Rakshasas wearing your shape.” (Thereupon) Rama destroyed those Rakshasas resembling him in shape and (various) others also.

sa: य आत्मनापनपते भृशं नरः स सर्वलोकस्य गुरुर्भवत्युता अनन्ततेजा: सुमनाः समाहितः स तेजसा सूर्य इवावभासते॥
en: The man, who is ashamed of his faults unknown to others, is respected by all men, being of illimitable luster, of an excellent mind; and his mind is intent on his inner self and his luster shines like the sun.

sa: ते वध्यमाना हरिभिर्बलिभिर्जितकाशिभिः। राक्षसा भग्नसंकल्पा लङ्कामभ्यपतन् भयात्॥
en: Thus slain by the powerful and victorious monkeys the Rakshasas lost their hearts and fled to Lanka in (great) fear.

sa: निमन्त्र्यन्तामासनैश्च सत्कारेण च भूयसां। नैतेष्वनुपविष्टेषु शक्यं केनचिदासितुम्॥
en: Invite them with plenty of seats and welcome them; for they remaining unseated, who is capable of taking his seat?

sa: द्विजातयो महाभागा वृद्धबालतपस्विषु। भवन्त्यक्रोधनाः प्रायो ह्यपराद्धेषु नित्यदा।॥
en: The highly renowned Brahmanas do not get angry with old men, ascetics and children, even if they repeatedly offend them.

sa: उपगीतोपनृत्तश्च गन्धर्वाप्सरसां गणैः। प्रीत्या प्रतिगृहीतश्च स्वर्गे दुन्दुभिनिःस्वनैः॥
en: He was gladly received in heaven with songs and dances by groups of Gandharvas and with the sound of cymbals.

sa: किं नु वक्ष्यति सम्राण्मां वर्णकः सुकृतो न वा। नान्यपिष्टं हि मत्स्यस्य चन्दनं किल रोचते॥
en: (Always do I remain in fear thinking) what the king of kings will say to me as about the unguents if they are not well pounded; because the king of the Matsya's does not like the sandal pounded by others.

sa: पापात्मा पापभावश्च कामबाणवशानुगः। अविनीतश्च दुष्टात्मा प्रत्याख्यातः पुनः पुनः॥ दर्शने दर्शने हन्याद् यदि जह्यां च जीवितम्। तद् धर्मे यतमानानां महान् धर्मो नशिष्यति॥
en: He is wicked-souled, of sinful disposition, impudent, villaneous and afflicted by Cupid's shaft. Although I have repeatedly rejected him, he will, I am sure, outrage me, whenever he happens to see me, and then I shall surely give up my life; although you are striving to acquire that virtue but on my death, surely you will lose that great one.

sa: प्रगृह्य कार्मुकश्रेष्ठं जातरूपपरिष्कृतम्। शरानादाय तीक्ष्णाग्रान् मर्मभेदान् प्रमाथिनः॥
en: Taking up the best of bows made of burnished gold, and sharp arrows capable of piercing to the very vitals.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच उक्तं भगवता जन्म रामादीनां पृथक् पृथक्। प्रस्थानकारणं ब्रह्मच्छ्रोतुमिच्छामि कथ्यताम्॥ कथं दाशरथी वीरौ भ्रातरौ रामलक्ष्मणौ। सम्प्रस्थितौ वने ब्रह्मन् मैथिली च यशस्विनी॥
en: Yudhishthira said : Your worshipful self has related (to me) separately of the birth of Rama and others, O Brahmana, I am (now) desirous of hearing of the cause of their exile. Tell me, O Brahmana, why the heroic sons of Dasharatha, the brothers Rama and Lakshmana, departed to the forest, together with the renowned Maithili (Sita, daughter of the king of Mithila).

sa: वसतस्तस्य रामस्य ततः शूर्पणखाकृतम्। खरेणासीन्महद् वैरं जनस्थाननिवासिना॥
en: While dwelling there, Rama had great enmity with Khara who had his abode in the Janasthana, on account of Shurpanakha.

sa: दिवसेनैव तत् कुर्याद् येन रात्रो सुखं वसेत्। अष्टमासेन तत् कुर्याद् येन वर्षाः सुखं वसेत्॥
en: That act should be done by one during the day, which will enable him to live in comfort during the night; and that should be done in eight months which will enable one to live in comfort throughout the year.

sa: विसर्जयित्वा राधेयं सर्वयादवनन्दनः। ततो जवेन महता तूर्णमश्वानचोदयत्।॥
en: And having dismissed the son of Radha, that delighter of all the Yadavas soon urged his horses to great speed.

sa: अथाब्रवीन्महाबाहुर्भीमसेनो महाबलः। राजानं बलिनां श्रेष्ठो गिरा सम्परिहर्षयन्॥
en: Then the exceeding strong and long armed Bhimasena, the foremost of mighty person encouraging the king greatly spoke these words

sa: उक्तं मया द्यूतकालेऽपि राजन् नेदं युक्तं वचनं प्रातिपेया तदौषधं पथ्यमिवातुरस्य न रोचते तव वैचित्रवीर्य।।२०
en: It was said by me at the time of the play, O king, that this was not proper; but, O son of Pratipa, this speech was disagreeable to you even as medicine to a sick man, O son of Vichitravirya.

sa: विदुर उवाच निषेवते प्रशस्तानि निन्दितानि न सेवते। अनास्तिकः श्रद्दधान एतत् पण्डितलक्षणम्॥ राजालक्षण संपन्नस्त्रैलोकस्याधिपो भवेत्।
en: Vidura said He is said to be a wise man, whom for a consciousness of the power of one's own self, exertion, forbearance and constancy in religion does not draw aside from the acquisition of the high ends in life.

sa: एकादशैताः पृतना एकतश्च समागताः। एकतश्च महाबाहुर्बहुरूपी धनंजयः॥
en: On one side are united those eleven (Akshauhinis) and on the other, Dhananjaya of great strength and of many forms.

sa: समादाय च राजानं प्रविवेश रसातलम्। दानवानां मुहूर्ताच्च तमानीतं न्यवेदयत्। तमानीतं नृपं दृष्ट्वा रात्रौ संगत्य दानवाः॥ प्रहृष्टमनसः सर्वे किंचिदुत्फुल्ललोचनाः। साभिमानमिदं वाक्यं दुर्योधनमथाब्रुवन्॥
en: Taking up the king, she brought him to the nether world and within a moment she came back to the Danavas and told them (that she had brought the king). Seeing the king brought before them in their assembly in the night, the Danavas. With well-pleased hearts and with expanded eyes in delight, thus spoke these flattering words to Duryodhana.

sa: हन्तेमां राजवसतिं राजपुत्रा ब्रवीम्यहम्॥ यथा राजकुलं प्राप्य सर्वान् दोषांस्तरिष्यथ। दुर्वसं चैव कौरव्य जानता राजवेश्मनि॥ अमानितैर्मानितैर्वा अज्ञातैः परिवत्सरम्। ततश्चतुर्दशे वर्षे चरिष्यथ यथासुखम्॥
en: Alas! it is woeful to stay with a king, I shall tell you. O princes, how you shall avert the calamities while residing in the royal premises. O Kauravas, whether respected or not, may you pass thus at the royal residence undiscovered by those who know you. Then in the fourteenth year you will act according to your own pleasure.

sa: अकालिकं कुरवो नाभविष्यन् पापेन चेत् पापमजातशत्रुः। इच्छेज्जातु त्वयि पापं विसृज्य निन्दा चेयं तव लोकेऽभविष्यत्॥
en: All these ministers of yours, ever devoted to work, wait together. It is through their firm determination (that they will not give back to the Pandavas their share of the kingdom) that the destruction of the Kurus will be accomplished.

sa: धृतराष्ट्रं पुरुस्कृत्य भीष्मद्रोणादयस्ततः। आसनेभ्योऽचलन् सर्वे पूजयन्तो जनार्दनम्॥
en: Bhishma, Drona and others following the example of Dhritarashtra rose up from their seats with the object of honouring Janardana.

sa: सिंहासनस्थो नृपतिद्धृतराष्ट्रो महाबलः। अन्वास्यमानः सततं विदुरेण महात्मना॥
en: That ruler of men, Dhritarashtra of great strength, while on the throne, was ever followed by the great souled Vidura.

sa: अप्येवं नो ब्राह्मणाः सन्ति वृद्धा बहुश्रुताः शीलवन्तः कुलीनाः। सांवत्सरा ज्योतिषि चाभियुक्ता नक्षत्रयोगेषु च निश्चयज्ञाः॥
en: Even among ourselves there are Brahmanas, old, well versed in the knowledge of the holy books, of good conduct of noble birth, acquainted with the events of the year and certain of their interpretation of the motion of the planets,

sa: सुपर्ण उवाच इयं विवस्वता पूर्वं श्रौतेन विधिना किल। गुरवे दक्षिणां दत्ता दक्षिणेत्युच्यते च दिक्॥
en: Suparna said This direction, in days of old, was given away by Vivasvat after the performance of a sacrifice according to the usual custom as a final present (Dakshina) to his spiritual guide; so this direction is called south (Dakshina).

sa: परिचारेषु तीर्थेषु विविधेष्वाकरेषु च। विज्ञातव्या मनुष्यैस्तैस्तर्कया सुविनीतया॥
en: In inner apartments, places of pilgrimage, mines and various other places (they should be searched after) with vigilance and humility.

sa: यद् वै ब्रूते कुरुमुख्यो महात्मा देवव्रतः सत्यसंधो मनीषी। सर्वं तदस्माभिरहत्य कार्य राज्यं स्वधर्मान् परिपालयद्भिः॥
en: What, that foremost among the Kurus, that great-souled one of divine vows, ever attached to truth, endued with intelligence, says, should is its entirely, be done by us, for the sake of our kingdom, and the duties of our order.

sa: सध्वजाः सपताकाश्च सशरासनतोमराः। रज्जुभिश्च विचित्राभिः सपाशाः सपरिच्छदाः॥
en: With flags and banners, with huge arrows, and bows and bowstrings and diverse suites of ropes, with nooses and lashes;

sa: लब्धचक्षुषमासीनं धृतराष्ट्र नराधिपाः। विस्मिता ऋषिभिः सार्धं तुष्टुवुर्मधुसूदनम्॥
en: The rulers of men, struck with wonder at the restoration eyesight to the sitting Dhritarashtra propitiated the slayer of Madhu.

sa: सा काक्षमाणा भर्तृणामुपयातमनिन्दिता। विलोभयामास परं वाक्यैर्वाक्यानि युञ्जती॥
en: Then expecting the return of her husbands that lady of irreproachable character, began to beguile him completely with intricate words.

sa: निषसादासने कृष्णो राजानश्च यथासनम्। दुःशासनः सात्यकये ददावासनमुत्तमम्॥
en: Krishna took his seat; so did all the kings, in their respective seats. Dushasana offered to Satyaki an excellent seat.

sa: पूर्वं चाभिगतं सन्तो भजन्ते पूर्वसारिणः। त्वं च श्रेष्ठतमो लोके सतामद्य जनार्दन। सततं सम्मतश्चैव सद्वृत्तमनुपालय॥
en: From the time of our ancestors, good men have befriended him who has been the first to come; and you, O Janardana, are the best person in this world; therefore act after this good example which has always been followed."

sa: शलभा यत्र सौवर्णास्तपनीयविभूषिताः। सुवर्णमणिचित्रं च कस्यैतद् धनुरुत्तमम्॥
en: Whose is this most excellent weapon variegated with gold and gems on which are golden insects set with brilliant stones?

sa: एवं पुनर्ब्रह्मचर्याप्रसक्तो हित्वा धर्मं यः प्रकरोत्यधर्मम्। अश्रद्दधत् परलोकाय मूढो हित्वा देहं तप्यते प्रेत्य मन्दः॥
en: In the same way, the fool, who despising virtue and without practicing religious meditation, gives himself up to vice, shows no regard (for the Supreme Being). The soul, after leaving the body and reaching the other world, comes to grief.

sa: अपि मे वाचं भाषमाणस्य काव्यां धर्मारामामर्थवतीमहिनाम्। अवेक्षेरन् धार्तराष्ट्राः समक्षं मां च प्राप्तं कुरवः पूजयेयुः॥
en: I hope that the sons of Dhritarashtra will attend to me when I speak to them words of wisdom, based on the principles of virtue and humanity and that the Kurus will treat me when I go there, with respect.

sa: तान् प्राप्ताञ्छितैर्बाणैर्नाराचान् रक्तभोजनान्। कृपश्चिच्छेद पार्थस्य शतशोऽथ सहस्रशः॥
en: Then with sharpened arrows "Kripa sundered into hundreds and thousands of pieces those blood-drinking shafts before they could reach (him).

sa: व्यायामसहमत्यर्थं तृणराजसमं महत्॥ सर्वायुधमहामात्रं शत्रुसम्बाधकारकम्। सुवर्णविकृतं दिव्यं श्लक्ष्णमायतमव्रणम्॥ अलं भारं गुरुं वोढुं दारुणं चारुदर्शनम्।
en: Capable of standing the greatest exercise, huge like a palmyra tree, the largest of all weapons, capable of withstanding the enemy, embellished with gold, celestials, smooth broad without a knot, beautiful and straight and capable of bearing a heavy weight.

sa: तं चेत् तदा ते सकुमारवृद्धा अवारयिष्यन् कुरवः समेताः। मम प्रियं धृतराष्ट्रोऽकरिष्यत् पुत्राणां च कृतमस्थाभविष्यत्॥
en: If at that time the sons of Kuru, who were assembled there, old and young, had prevented this, Dhritarashtra would have done what would have pleased me and such behaviour would also have been to the benefit of his sons.

sa: एकनाभिपतत्यह्रा योजनानि चतुर्दश। यानमश्वतरीयुक्तं दास्ये तस्मै तदप्यहम्॥
en: This chariot drawn by excellent horses that traverses fourtcen yojanas in a single day, that too shall I give him.

sa: रेवं युक्तं कर्म चिकीर्षसि त्वम्। अपक्रामे: स्वं प्रदायैव तेषां मा गास्त्वं वै देवयानात् पथोऽद्य॥
en: If you are desirous of doing this deed, attended with such results, simply because your advisers wish it, then abdicate everything to them and go away. You should not now forsake the path leading to the region of the gods.

sa: तस्मिन्नुच्चार्यमाणे तु गन्धर्वेण वचस्तथा॥ भूमेर्विवरमन्वैच्छं प्रवेष्टुं व्रीडयान्वितः।
en: When these counsels of ours were disclosed by the Gandharva, I desired then in great shame to enter the earth.

sa: अथ त्वाचार्यमुख्येन शरान् सृष्टाञ्छिलाशितान्। न्यवारयच्छितैर्बाणैर्जुनो जयतां वरः॥
en: one Arjuna, the foremost of victors, warded off, with sharp arrows, the sharpened arrows shot by the foremost of preceptors.

sa: यथा मनुर्महातेजा लोकानां परिरक्षिता। एवमेष महातेजाः प्रजानुग्रहकारकः॥
en: He is the preserver of the world like the highly powerful Manu himself. Highly powerful and kind to his subjects.

sa: एवमेतैर्महाभागैर्महर्षिगणसाधुभिः। पूजितः प्रययौ कृष्णः कुरूणां सदनं प्रति॥
en: In this way worshipped by this blessed group of great qualities, Krishna set out for the encampment of the Kurus.

sa: दैवतेभ्यः पितृभ्यश्च संविभागोऽतिथिष्वपि। असंत्यागश्च भृत्यानां श्रेय एतदसंशयम्॥
en: A just distribution of one's riches among the gods, the Pitris, and guests, and adherence to servants,—these, forsooth, constitute excellence.

sa: इतीदं हृदयग्रन्थि बुद्धिचिन्तामयं दृढम्। विमुच्य सुखमासीत विशोकश्छिन्नसंशयः॥
en: Solving this hard problem of the understanding and reflection, and removing all doubt, one should renounce sorrow and live happily.

sa: उपतिष्ठति तिष्ठन्तं गच्छन्तमनुगच्छति। करोति कुर्वतः कर्म च्छायेवानुविधीयते॥
en: Like his shadow it takes rest when he rests, goes on when he goes on, and acts when he acts.

sa: यथाऽऽदित्यः प्रातरुद्यंस्तमः सर्वं व्यपोहति। कल्याणमाचरन्नेवं सर्वपापं व्यपोहति॥
en: As the sun rising on the morning removes all darkness, so does one dissipate all his sins by acting virtuously.

sa: कथमेतां पितामह। निवर्तयेयं पापानि तृष्णया कारिता वयम्॥
en: How, O grandfather, shall we remove this thirst for riches. Alas, through that thirst we have committed many sinful deeds.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच वृत्रेण परमार्थज्ञ दृष्टा मन्येऽऽत्मनो गतिः। शुभा तस्मात् स सुखितो न शोचति पितामह॥
en: Yudhisthira said-O who are conversant with the highest object of knowledge, I think that Vritra behold before hand the excellent end that awaited him. It is for this, O grandfather, that he was happy and did not sucumb to grief.

sa: उत्तरापथजन्मानः कीर्तयिष्यामि तानपि। यौनकाम्बोजगान्धारा: किराता बर्बरैः सह॥
en: I shall also name those that are born in the northern region. They are Yaunas, Kambojas, Ghandharas, Kiratas, and Barbbaras.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच के पूज्या: के नमस्कार्याः कान् नमस्यसि भारत। एतन्मे सर्वमाचक्ष्व येभ्यः स्पृहयसे नृप॥
en: Yudhishthira said Who are deserving of adoration? Who are they to whom one may bow? Who are they, O Bharata, to whom you would lower your head? Who, again, are they whom you like? Tell me all this, O prince.

sa: यथामति यथापाठं तथा विद्या फलिष्यति। सर्वस्तरतु दुर्गाणि सर्वो भद्राणि पश्यतु॥ श्रावयेच्चतुरो वर्णान् कृत्वा ब्राह्मणमग्रतः।
en: Let all disciples master all difficulties, and let all of them be crowned with success. You are competent to expound the scriptures to persons of all the castes. Only ye should, while delivering instructions address a Brahmana, first of all.

sa: तत्रेतिहासं वक्ष्यामि धर्मस्यास्योपबृंहणम्। दह्यमानः पापकृत्या जगाम जनमेजयः॥
en: I shall now tell you the story of his expiation. Burning with the recollection of his sin, Janamejaya wandered about.

sa: वासुदेव उवाच कुकुराधिप यान् मन्ये शृणु तान् मे विवक्षतः। नारदस्य गुणान् साधून् संक्षेपेण नराधिप॥
en: Vasudeva said O chief of the Kukuras, listen to me as I describe shortly those good qualities of Narada which I know, I king! Narada is as well-read in the scriptures as he is good and pious in his conduct

sa: ततस्त्वल्पेन कालेन तुष्टो जलधरस्तदा। तस्योपकारनियतामिमां वाचमुवाच ह॥
en: Thus adored, the Cloud became very soon pleased with his worshipper, and uttered these words of benefit to that Brahmana:

sa: पुत्रपौत्रवधूभृत्यैराकीर्णमपि सर्वतः। भार्याहीनं गृहस्थस्य शून्यमेव गृहं भवेत्॥
en: A house-holder's home, even if filled with sons, grandsons daughters-in-law and servants, is regarded empty if there is no housewife.

sa: धर्मशास्त्राणि वेदाश्च षडङ्गानि नराधिप। श्रेयसोऽर्थे विधीयन्ते नरस्याक्लिष्टकर्मणः॥
en: O king! All the scriptures of righteousness and the Vedas with six angas proceed for the welfare of sinless one.

sa: तस्याकाशे निपतितः स्नेहस्तिष्ठति योऽपरः। स संघातत्वमापन्नो भूमित्वमनुगच्छति॥
en: While dropping from the sky, the liquid portion of fire being solidified again became what is known as the Earth.

sa: वसिष्ठ उवाच एवमप्रतिबुद्धत्वादवुद्धमनुवर्तते। देहाद् देहसहस्राणि तथा समभिपद्यते॥
en: Vasistha said Thus on account of his forgetfulness the Soul follows Ignorance and acquires thousands of bodies one after another.

sa: महत्सर इवोत्फुल्लं कुमुदच्छरितोदकम्॥ ताराढ्यं कुमुदाकारमाकाशं निर्मलं बहु।
en: Soon the sky cleared and became spangled with myriads of stars appearing like a splendid lake smiling with blooming lilies.

sa: यथा पुष्पफलोपेतो बहुशाखो महाद्रुमः। आतमनो नाभिजानीते क्व मे पुष्पं क्व मे फलम्॥ एवमात्मा न जानीते क्व गमिष्ये कुतस्त्वहम्। अन्यो ह्यत्रान्तरात्मास्ति यः सर्वमनुपश्यति॥
en: As a large tree enveloped with numberless branches and filled with many flowers and fruits, does not know in which part it has flowers and in which it has fruits, similarly the Soul, as modified by birth and other qualities, does not know whence it has come and whither it is to go. There is, however, an inner Soul, which sees every thing.

sa: तमुवाच महादेवः सान्त्वपूर्वमिदं वचः। पुत्रशोकाभिसंतप्तं कृष्णद्वैपायनं तदा॥
en: Consoling the Island-born Rishi who was burning with grief on account of his son, Mahadeva said these words to him

sa: तत्र ब्रह्मर्षयश्चैव सर्वे राजर्षयस्तथा। लोकपालाश्च लोकेशं साध्याश्च बहुभिः सह।॥ आदित्याश्चैव रुद्राश्च दिवाकरनिशाकरौ। वसवो मरुतश्चैव सागरा: सरितस्तथा॥ अश्विनौ देवगन्धर्वास्तथा नारदपर्वतौ। विश्वावसुश्च गन्धर्वः सिद्धाश्चाप्सरसस्तथा॥
en: There were all the twice-born Rishis and royal sages and the Regents of the world and the Sadhyas along with the Vasus, and the Adityas, the Rudras, and the Sun and the Moon, and the Maruts, and the Oceans, and the rivers, and the Ashvins, the Deities, the Gandharvas, and Narada, and Parvata, and the Gandharva Vishvavasu, and the Siddhas, and the Apsaras.

sa: उग्रसेन उवाच यस्य संकल्पते लोको नारदस्य प्रकीर्तने। मन्ये स गुणसम्पन्नो ब्रूहि तन्मम पृच्छतः॥
en: Ugrasena said All persons seem to be auxious to describe of the merits of Narada. I think that celestial Rishi must really be endued with every sort of merit. I ask you tell me this, O Keshava.

sa: तामुवाच महाबाहो ब्रह्मवध्यां पितामहः॥ स्वरेण मधुरेणाथ सान्त्वयन्निव भारत। मुच्यतां विदशेन्द्रोऽयं मत्प्रियं कुरु भाविनि॥ ब्रूहि किं ते करोम्यद्य कामं किं त्वमिहेच्छसि॥
en: The Grandfather at last, O you of great arms, addressed Brahmanicide in sweet words as if from the desire of pacifying her, and said.-0 amiable one, let the king of the gods, who is a favourite of mine, be freed from you. Tell me, what shall I do for you? What wish of yours shall I satisfy?

sa: वातवर्ष महच्चासीन्न चागच्छति मे प्रिया। किं नु तत् कारणं येन साद्यापि न निवर्तते॥
en: O, what a great storm and a terrible shower took place to-day! Alas, you have come not come back yet, O dear wife! Woe is on me, what must be the cause of her not returning yet.

sa: योगिनामपि यो रोगी कारणानां च कारणम्। यतो लोकाः सम्भवन्ति न भवन्ति यतः पुनः॥
en: To him who is the Yogin of all Yogins, and the cause of all causes; to him from whom all the worlds come into being, and to whom all the worlds return when they cease to exist.

sa: मुच्यते बन्धनात् पुष्पं फलं वृक्षात् प्रमुच्यते। क्लिश्यन्नपि सुतं स्नेहैः पिता पुत्रं न मुञ्चति॥
en: The flower is seen to drop down from the stalk. The fruit is seen to drop down from the tree. But the father, in whatever difficulty he may be, moved by parental affection, never leaves the son.

sa: अशोभत महादेवः पौर्णमास्यामिवोडुराट्। तस्य तेजोभवो वह्निः समेघः सन्तयित्नुमान्।।२४५ सहस्रमिव सूर्याणां सर्वमापूर्य धिष्ठितः। ईश्वरः सुमहातेजाः संवर्तक इवानलः॥ युगान्ते सर्वभूतानां दिधक्षुरिव चोद्यतः।
en: Mahadeva shone like the full-moon. The fire born of his energy shone ini effulgence like lightning that flashes amid clouds. It seemed as if a thousand suns rose there, filling every quarter with a dazzling splendour. That energy of the Supreme Lord looked like the Samvartaka fire which destroys all creatures at the end of the Yoga.

sa: सौतिरुवाच कथयिष्यामि ते सर्वं पुराणं वेदसम्मितम्॥ जगौ यद् भगवान् व्यासो राज्ञः पारिक्षितस्य वै।
en: Sauti said I shall recount to you that ancient history, which is quite of a piece with the Vedas, and which the illustrious Vaishampayana recited to the son of Parikshit on the occasion of the great Snake-sacrifice.

sa: अथ प्रथमकल्पेन सत्यवन् संकरो भवेत्। आयुः शक्तिं च कालं च निर्दिश्य तप आदिशेत्॥
en: If, O Satyavat, by adopting the way mentioned first, confusion sets in, the king, considering the span of human life, the strength of human beings, and the nature of the time that has come, should give punishments.

sa: प्रोक्षिता यत्र पशवो वधं प्राप्स्यन्ति वै मखे। यत्र पादश्चतुर्थो वै धर्मस्य न भविष्यति॥
en: In the sacrifices that will be celebrated in that age, animals, after dedication with the help of sacred Mantras, will be killed. As regards virtue, again, it will lose one quarter; only three quarters thereof will remain.

sa: दानं त्यागः शोभना मूर्तिरद्भ्यो भूतप्लाव्यं तपसा वै शरीरम्। सरस्वतीनैमिषपुष्करेषु ये चाप्यन्ये पुण्यदेशाः पृथिव्याम्॥
en: Repairing to the Sarasvati, the Naimisha forest, the Pushkara lake, and the other sacred spots on Earth, one should make gifts, practise renunciation, render his aspect amiable, O king, and purify his body with baths and penances.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच जज्ञे बहुशं परमत्युदारं यं द्वीपमध्ये सुतमात्मयोगात्। पराशरात् सत्यवती महर्षि तस्मै नमोऽज्ञानतमोनुदाय॥
en: Vaishampayana said I bow to that great Rishi who is the remover of Darkness, and whom Satyavati bore to Parashara in the midst of an island, who is endued with great knowledge and great liberality of soul.

sa: विष्णु उवाच आदित्यचन्द्रावनिलानलौ च द्यौर्भूमिरापो वसवोऽथ विश्वे। धतार्यमा शुक्रबृहस्पती च रुद्राः ससाध्या वरुणोऽथ गोपः॥ ब्रह्मा शक्रो मारुतो ब्रह्म सत्यं वेदा यज्ञा दक्षिणा वेदवाहाः। सोमो यष्टा यच्च हव्यं हविश्व रक्षा दीक्षा संयमा ये च केचित्॥ स्वाहा वौषट् ब्राह्मणाः सौरभेयी धर्मे चायं कालचक्रं बलं च। यशो दमो बुद्धिमतां स्थितिश्च शुभाशुभं ये मुनयश्च सप्त॥ अग्र्या बुद्धिर्मनसा दर्शने च स्पर्शश्चाग्र्यः कर्मणां या च सिद्धिः। गणा देवानामूष्मपाः सोमपाच लेखाः सुयामास्तुषिता ब्रह्मकायाः॥ आभासुरा गन्ध
en: Vishnu said The Sun, the Moon, Wind, Fire, Heaven, Earth, the Vasus, the Vishvedevas, Datri, Aryaman Shukra, Brihaspati the Rudras, the Saddhyas, Varuna, Gopa, Brahman, Shakra, Maruts, the Upanishads that teach a knowledge of Brahma, Truth, the Vedas, the Sacrifices, Sacrificial Presents, Brahmanas reciting the Vedas, Soma, Sacrificer, the shares of the gods in sacrificial offerings, clarified butter poured in sacrifices, Raksha, Diksha, all kinds of restraints in the form of vows and fasts and rigid observances, Svaha, Vashat, the Brahmanas, the celestial cow, the foremost acts of piety, the wheel of Time, Strength, Fame, Selfcontrol, the Steadiness of all intelligent persons, all acts of goodness and otherwise, the seven Rishis, Understanding of the foremost order, all kinds of excellent

sa: पृथ्वी उवाच यथा महार्णवे क्षिप्तः क्षिप्रं लेष्टुर्विनश्यति। तथा दुश्चरितं सर्वे त्रिवृत्यां च निमज्जति॥
en: The Earth said As a clod of earth when thrown into the great ocean quickly dissolves away so every sort of sin disappears by the three high qualifications of officiation at sacrifices teaching, and receiving of gifts.

sa: यथा यथा हि सद्वृत्तमालम्बन्तीतरे जनाः। तथा तथा सुखं प्राप्य प्रेत्य चेह च मोदते।॥
en: Wherever persons of the lowest caste follow the conduct of the good, they succeed in acquiring happiness on account of which they are able to pass their time in happiness both in this world and the next.

sa: भीष्म उवाच इत्येतद् ब्रुवतो राजन् ब्राह्मणस्य मया श्रुतम्। कथां कथयतः पुण्यां धर्मज्ञस्य पुरातनीम्॥
en: Bhishma said I heard this, O king, from my preceptor while he was discoursing upon the subject of Brahmanas. I heard this from that pious person when he recounted the old and sacred declarations of this topic.

sa: स्वेनात्मना चक्षुरिव प्रणेता निशात्यये तमसा संवृतात्मा। ज्ञानं तु विज्ञानगुणेन युक्तं कर्माशुभं पश्यति वर्जनीयम्॥
en: As the eye, when night passes away and the veil of darkness is gone, leads its possessor by its own power, so the Understanding, when it becomes endued with Knowledge, sees all evils which should be shunned.

sa: अनुगम्य विनाशान्ते निवर्तन्ते ह बान्धवाः। अग्नौ प्रक्षिप्य पुरुषं ज्ञातयः सुहृदस्तथा॥ नास्तिकान् निरनुक्रोशान् नरान् पापमते स्थितान्। वामतः कुरु विस्रब्धं परं प्रेप्सुरतन्द्रितः॥
en: Following the body after one's death, one's relatives and kinsmen and friends return placing it on the funeral pyre. Do you unhesitatingly shun those who are men sceptics, who are destitute of mercy, and who are given to wicked ways, and do you try to seek, without listlessness or apathy, that which is for your greatest good.

sa: श्वपच उवाच भिक्षामन्यामाहरेति न च कर्तुमिहार्हसि। न नूनं कार्यमेतद् वै हर कामं श्वजाघनीम्॥
en: The Chandala said Do you beg for something else. You should not do such a thing. Verily you should not do such an act. If, however, you like, you may take away this piece of dog's meat.

sa: याज्ञवल्क्य उवाच तत्त्वानां सर्वसंख्या च कालसंख्या तथैव च। मया प्रोक्ताऽऽनुपूर्वेण संहारमपि मे शृणु॥
en: I have, one after another, told you the order of the creation, with their total number, of the various principles, as also the extent of the duration of each. Hear as I tell you of their destruction.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच कथं नु युक्तः पृथिवीं चरेदस्मद्विधो नृपः। नित्यं कैश्च गुणैर्युक्तः संगपाशाद् विमुच्यते॥
en: Yudhishthira said How, O grandfather, should a king like us act in this world, keeping in view the great object of acquisition? What attributes, again, should he always possess so that he may be liberated from attachments.

sa: अथ व्यवस्थितान् दृष्ट्वा धार्तराष्ट्रान् कपिध्वजः। प्रवृत्ते शस्त्रसम्पाते धनुरुद्यम्य पाण्डवः॥ हृषीकेशं तदा वाक्यमिदमाह महीपते।
en: O king of the world, the ape standard son of Pandu secing Dhritarashtra's people marshalled in battle bent, and missiles having been just began to be discharged, raised up his bow, and spoke thus to Hrishikesh :

sa: विचरामि महीं देवि यथा हन्यामहं नृपम्। एतद् व्रतफलं देवि परमस्मिन् यथा हि मे॥
en: I wander about in the earth, O goddess, with the one purpose of obtaining the means of death of that king, and this is the vow I have taken, O goddess, in everything else that I do.”

sa: पुत्रस्तु तव सम्भ्रान्तः सौभद्रस्याप्लुतो रथम्॥ स कुञ्जरस्थो विसृजनिषूनरिषु पार्थिवः। बभौ रश्मीनिवादित्यो भुवनेषु समुत्सृजन्॥
en: At this juncture, your son with speed rushed, against the car or Subhadra's son. King Bhagadatta riding on his elephant and discharging arrows at the foc appeared resplendent like the sun scattering his rays on the earth.

sa: द्रोण उवाच सत्यं वदसि कौरव्य दुराधर्षो धनंजयः। अहं तु तत् करिष्यामि यथैनं प्रसहिष्यसि॥
en: Drona said o foremost descendant of the Kuru race, you speak all that is true. Really Dhananjaya is incapable of suffering defeat. But I myself will so act by which you will be able to bear him.

sa: उत्पतन्ति हि मे बाणा धनुः प्रस्फुरतीव च। योगमस्त्राणि गच्छन्ति क्रूर मे वर्तते मतिः॥
en: My arrows are coming out of their own accord, and my bow seems to gape. My weapons are falling off when I am trying to fix them on the bow-string, and my mind is losing and warmth.

sa: प्राजापत्यं विश्वकृतं प्रस्वापं नाम भारत। न हीदं वेद रामोऽपि पृथिव्यां वा पुमान् क्वचित्।।१२
en: It appertains to the lord of all creatures (Brahma) and was manufactured by the divine architect; it is named Prasvapa, O Bharata. It is not known even to Rama nor to any body else on the earth.

sa: न चेदेवं प्राप्तकालं वचो मे मोहाविष्टः प्रतिपत्स्यस्यबुद्ध्या। तप्स्यन्ते एतदन्ताः स्थ सर्वे सत्यामेतां भारतीमीरयामि॥
en: If through perverted understanding, and possessed by folly, you do not listen to these reasonable words of mine, then-this I tell you for certain-you shall have to rue your folly hereinafter. Therefore let the war end here."

sa: दुर्योधन उवाच भीष्मः सेनाप्रणेताऽऽसीद् वयसा विक्रमेण च। श्रुतेन चोपसम्पन्नः सर्वैर्योधगणैस्तथा॥ तेनातियशसा कर्ण जता शत्रुगणान् मम। सुयुद्धेन दशाहानि पालिताः स्मो महात्मना॥
en: Duryodhana said Owing to his prowess, seniority, knowledge of the Srutis and the support he obtained from all the warriors, he (Bhishma) was the leader of our host. In the fair battle of these ten days that highly glorious one of generous soul, O Karna, slew a large number of my foes and protected my own army.

sa: कार्पण्यदोषोपहतस्वभावः पृच्छामि त्वां धर्मसम्मूढचेताः। यच्छ्रेयः स्यान्निश्चितं ब्रूहि तन्मे शिष्यस्तेऽहं शाधि मां त्वां प्रपन्नम्॥
en: I am afraid of the sin of race extermination. I am confounded about my duty. I ask you, tell me what is assuredly good for me. I am your disciple, instruct me, I am at your disposal.

sa: अप्रशते नरे चैव न युद्धं रोचते मम। इमं में शृणु रजेन्द्र संकल्पं पूर्वचिन्तितम्॥
en: One who is a female, one who bears a feminine designation, one who is disabled, one who has got only one son, and one who is a mean fellow, with these I do not like to fight.

sa: समाद्रवन्त गाङ्गेयं श्रुत्वा पार्थस्य भाषितम्। प्रत्युद्ययुस्तावकाश्च समेतांस्तान् महारथान्॥ यथाशक्ति यथोत्साहं तन्मे निगदतः शृणु।
en: All advanced against the son of Ganga. As to your warriors who comforted, to the best of their abilities and to the best of their energies, hose united and mighty car-warriors of the enemy, hear me speak.

sa: दिव्यमस्त्रं विकुर्वाणान् प्रसहेद् वा परान् मम। अन्योदुर्योधनात् कर्णाच्छकुनेश्चापि सौबलात्॥ दुःशासनचतुर्थानां नान्यं पश्यामि पञ्चमम्।
en: Who else again will face my enemies when they will display their celestial weapons. Save and except Duryodhana, Karna, Shakuni the son of Subala and Dushasana as their fourth; I do not indeed see a fifth man.

sa: नारद उवाच ययातिं नाहुषं चैव मृतं सृञ्जय शुश्रुम। राजसूयशतैरिष्ट्वा सोऽश्वमेधशतेन च॥ पुण्डरीकसहस्रेण वाजपेयशतैस्तथा। अतिरात्रसहस्रेण चातुर्मास्यैश्च कामतः। अग्निष्टोमैश्च विविधैः सत्रैश्च प्राज्यदक्षिणैः॥
en: Narada said O Srinjaya, we heard also that Yayati, the son of Nahusa, was carried away by Death. Having celebrated a hundred Rajasuya sacrifices, a hundred Horse-sacrifices, thousand Pundarikas, a hundred Vajapeya sacrifices, a thousand Atiratra sacrifices, numerous Chaturmasya sacrifices. Many Agnistomas and diverse other kind of sacrifices, all attended with the giving away of profuse Dakshinas.

sa: ततो राजा द्रुपदो राजसिंहः सर्वान् राज्ञः कुलतः संनिशाम्य। दशार्णकस्य नृपतेस्तनूजां शिखण्डिने वरयामास दारान्॥
en: Thereupon the king Drupada, the lion among kings, having heard of the (respective) purity if descent of the lineage of all kings, chose the daughter of the king of the Dasharnaka territory as the wife of Shikhandin.

sa: आपूर्यमाणमचलप्रतिष्ठं समुद्रमापः प्रविशन्ति यद्वत्। तद्वत् कामा यं प्रविशन्ति सर्वे स शान्तिमाप्नोति न कामकामी॥
en: He, in whom all objects of senses enter, like the ocean in which various waters enter, but do not make any increase or decrease, attains to peace, but not he who desire to have objects of senses.

sa: आदित्य इव तेजस्वी लोककान्तः शशी यथा। राजा सर्वस्य लोकस्य देवो वैश्रवणो यथा ॥
en: Bright as the sun that lights the sky and dear as the moon to every eye, he pleases all his subjects with bounties like to those of as Vaisravana. (Another name of Kubera, the god of gold.)

sa: गत्वा तु रक्षोधिपतेः शशंसुः सेनापतिं पावकसूनुशस्तम्। तच्चापि तेषां वचनं निशम्य रक्षोधिपः क्रोधवशं जगाम॥
en: Going to the lord of the Rākşasas, they ar prised hin, of the dealth of his general at the hands of the Fire-god's offspring. And hearing those words of theirs, the Rākşasas lord was overcome with rage.

sa: एतत्तदाश्रमपदमस्माकं वरवर्णिनि। पर्णशाला तथा चित्रा दृश्यते शुभदर्शने॥ यत्र त्वं राक्षसेन्द्रेण रावणेन हृता बलात्।
en: Do you behold there, O you of a beautiful person, O you of auspicious looks, our hermitage and the beautiful cottage of leaves, where from you had been carried away by force by the lord of Raksasas.

sa: अथ मन्त्रानपि जपनरौद्रमस्त्रमुदीरयन्। शरान्भूयः समादाय रामः क्रोधसमन्वितः॥ मुमोच च महातेजाश्चापमायम्य वीर्यवान्। ताशराराक्षसेन्द्राय चिक्षेपाच्छिन्नसायकः॥
en: Then reciting a formula, the exceedingly energetic Rāma endowed with prowess, wrought up with wrath, engaged in incessantly shooting his shafts, taking his Rudra weapon and again seizing his arrows, discharged them at that lord of Raksasas.

sa: एतत्तदाश्रमपदमस्माकं वरवर्णिनि। पर्णशाला तथा चित्रा दृश्यते शुभदर्शने॥ यत्र त्वं राक्षसेन्द्रेण रावणेन हृता बलात्।
en: Do you behold there, O you of a beautiful person, O you of auspicious looks, our hermitage and the beautiful cottage of leaves, where from you had been carried away by force by the lord of Raksasas.

sa: जयत्यतिबलो रामो लक्ष्मणश्च महाबलः। राजा जयति सुग्रीवो राघवेणाभिपालितः॥ दासोऽहं कोसलेन्द्रस्य रामस्याक्लिष्टकर्मणः। हनूमाञ्शत्रुसैन्यानां निहन्ता मारुतात्मजः॥ न रावणसहस्रं मे युद्धे प्रतिबलं भवेत्। शिलाभिश्च प्रहरतः पादपैश्च सहस्रशः॥ अर्दयित्वा पुरीं लङ्कामभिवाद्य च मैथिलीम्। समृद्धार्थो गमिष्यामि मिषतां सर्वरक्षसाम्॥
en: He loudly proclaimed, “Victory to the exceedingly strong Rāma and to the mighty Lakşmaņa! And victory to king Sugrīva, protected of Rāghava! I am the servant of the Sovereign of Kosala, Rāma of untiring deeds, (I am) Hanuman, the destroyer of hostile hosts, offspring of the Wind-god. And a thousand Rāvana's cannot cope with me in conflict, when I shall hurl crags and trees by thousands. In the very presence of all the Rākşasa, shall I, having desolated the city of Lankā and paid my reverence to Maithli, go away, my end being compassed."

sa: स राजपुत्र्या प्रतिवेदितार्थः कपिः कृतार्थः परिहृष्टचेताः। तदल्पशेष प्रसमीक्ष्य कार्य दिशं धुंदीची मनसा जगाम॥
en: Thus furnished with the intentions of the princess, the monkey, having gained his object, and, growing exceedingly exhilarated in his heart, reviewed the small work that yet remained for him, became bent upon proceeding to the north.

sa: यः शृणोति सदा लोके नरः पापात्प्रमुच्यते। पुत्रकामश्च पुत्रान्वै धनकामो धनानि च॥ लभते मनुजो लोके श्रुत्वा रामाभिषेचनम्। महीं विजयते राजा रिपूंश्चाप्यधितिष्ठति॥
en: He, who on this earth, shall hear (this story) shall be divested of sins. People, wishing for children, shall obtain the same and those, wishing for riches, shall get by them. Thus people on this earth shall attain to their wished for objects hearing of this Răma's installationthe king may conquer the earth and subdue his foes.

sa: रक्ताक्षाः सुबहुव्यामा नीलाञ्जनचयोपमाः। शूलानुद्यम्य खङ्गांश्च निशितांश्च परश्वधान्॥ भिन्दिपालांश्च परिघान्गदाश्च मुसलानि च। तालस्कन्धांश्च विपुलान्क्षेपणीयान्दुरासदान्॥
en: The Räkşasa measuring each many a vyama and red, eyed, and resembling masses of darkblue collyrium, went out upraising darts and swords and sharpened axes and bhindipälas and parighas and maces and huge talaskandhas and irrisistible Kșepaņis.

sa: आप्लवन्तः प्लवन्तश्च गर्जन्तश्च प्लवंगमाः। तमचिन्त्यसमह्यं च ह्यद्भुतं लोमहर्षणम् ॥ ददृशुः सर्वभूतानि सागरे सेतुबन्धनम्।
en: The monkeys, leaping and bounding and roaring, as well as all creatures, beheld that building of the bridge the ocean, on inconceivable, and marvellous, displaying skill past thought and capable of making one's hair stand on end.

sa: सीतानिमित्तजो मृत्युस्त्वया दूरादुपाहृतः। मैथिली सह रामेण विशोका विहरिष्यति॥ अल्पपुण्या त्वहं घोरे पतिता शोकसागरे।
en: And death, in consequence of Maithili, has taken you far away. And she, shorn of all sorrow, shall enjoy in the company of Rāma, and I, of limited piety, am now sunk in the ocean of grief.

sa: विभीषणस्य मन्त्रोऽयं मम लक्ष्मण रोचते॥ सुग्रीवः पण्डितो नित्यं भवान्मन्त्रविचक्षणः। उभाभ्यां संप्रधार्थिं रोचते यत्तदुच्यताम्॥
en: O Lakşmaņa, this counsel of Vibhīşaņa appear to me as most sound. Sugrīva is a ways greatly wise, and you are greatly proficient in counsel. Do you, holding a conference, intimate to me what you think becoming."

sa: आस्फोटयामास चुचुम्ब पुच्छं ननन्द चिक्रीड जगौ जगाम। स्तम्भानरोहनिपपात भूमौ निदर्शयन् स्वां प्रकृति कपीनाम्॥
en: Thereat, (Hanumăn) struck at his arms with his hands, kissed his tail, exhibited signs of glee, frolicked, sang, darted towards the pillars, shoot up to the top thereof, and jumbed down to the earth, manifesting his monkey-nature.

sa: संजय उवाच शृणु राजन् यथा वृत्तं संग्राम ब्रुवतो मम। वीराणां शत्रुभिः सार्धं देहपाप्मासुनाशनम्॥
en: Sanjaya said O monarch, do you hear me, who am describing to you how that battle, which was destructive of the bodies, sins and lives of persons, waged between the heroes (on our side) and the enemies.

sa: उपमन्युरुवाच नास्ति शर्वसमो देवो नास्ति शर्वसमा गतिः। नास्ति शर्वसमो दाने नास्ति शर्वसमो रणे॥
en: Upamanyu said There is no god like Sarva. There is no end or refuge like Sarva. There is none who can grant so inany or so high boons. There is none who is his equal in battle.

sa: क्षत्रधर्मे स्थिरो भूत्वा युध्यस्व पुरुषो भव॥ यत् तदा हृष्यसे मूढ ग्लहन्नक्षैः सभातले। फलमद्य प्रपश्यस्व कर्मणस्तस्य दुर्मते॥ निहत्तास्ते दुरात्मानो येऽस्मानवहसन् पुरा।
en: The energetic Sahadeva, having assailed his foes thus, addressed him, recollecting (his past misdeeds), in these words:-"Observing the duties of a Kshatriya, fight with me and show yourself to be a man! You, O fool, rejoiced greatly in the midst of the assembly, while gambling with dice. Receive now, O wicked man, the fruit of the act.

sa: ततस्तु ते तस्य वधेन भूरिणा मनस्विनो नैर्ऋतराजबान्धवाः। विनेदुरुच्चैर्व्यथिता रघूत्तमं हरिं समीक्ष्यैव यथा मतंगजाः॥
en: At his (Kumbhakarna's) great destruction, the intelligent adherents of the king of Nairtas, aggrieved exceedingly, began to cry at the sight of that best of the Raghus, even as mad elephants cry at sight of a lion.

sa: गालव उवाच पापिष्ठेभ्यो ह्यनर्हिः स नरोऽस्तु स्वपापकृत्। दत्त्वा दानं कीर्तयतु यस्ते हरति पुष्करम्॥
en: Galava said Let him who has stolen your stalks be more infamous than a sinful man. Let him be sinful in his deeds towards his kinsmen and relatives. Let him proclaim the gifts he makes to others.

sa: विश्वावसुरुवाच पञ्चविशं यदेतत् ते प्रोक्तं ब्राह्मणसत्तम। तथा तन्न तथा चेति तद् भवान् वक्तुमर्हति॥
en: Vishvavasu then said You have, O foremost of Brahmanas, said that Individual Soul is indestructible and truly undistinguished from the Supreme Soul. This, however, is difficult to understand. You should once more explain this subject to me.

sa: तथेति च स राजानमुवाच वसुधाधिपम्। सम्भाराः सम्भ्रियन्तां ते तुरगश्च विमुच्यताम्॥ सरय्वाश्चोत्तरे तीरे यज्ञभूमिर्विधीयताम्।
en: Then that Brāhmana said to the lord of the earth, the king, So be it! Get order the necessary provisions procured, free the horse set, and prepare a sacrificial ground on the north bank of the Sarayd.

sa: सुमुखैर्दुर्मुखं भीमः शरैर्निन्ये यमक्षयम्। ततस्तमेवाधिरथिः स्यन्दनं दुर्मुखे हते॥ आस्थितः प्रबभौ राजन् दीप्यमान इवांशुमान्। शयानं भिन्नमर्माणं दुर्मुखं शोणितोक्षितम्॥ दृष्ट्वा कर्णोऽश्रुपूर्णाक्षो मुहूर्त नाभ्यवर्तत। तं गतासुमतिक्रम्य कृत्वा कर्णः प्रदक्षिणम्॥
en: And keen points, Bhima dispatched Durmukha to the abode of Death. Then upon the slaughter of Durmukha, the son of Adiratha mounting in the car of this slain hero, looked beautiful like the effulgent fire, O king. Then beholding Durmukha prostrate, with his vital limbs torn off and weltering in his blood, Karna with his eyes overflowing with tears, refrained from the fight for a while. Circumambulating that slain prince and passing over him.
